SS&C prides itself on hiring diverse, honest, dynamic individuals who value collaboration, accountability, and innovation, to name a few.

Role: Associate – Data Analyst

Locations: Copenhagen, Denmark | Hybrid 6 days a month

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Associate Data Analyst to join our Copenhagen office and become part of a specialised, collaborative, and close-knit team working at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and securities litigation.

As an Associate, you will contribute to a broad range of research and analytical activities, including evaluating securities class actions, estimating potential investor recoveries, analysing settlement opportunities, and supporting the identification and assessment of new business opportunities.

The position combines financial analysis, data analysis, litigation research, and business research. You will work with financial and trading data, legal and regulatory filings, institutional investor information, and internal analytical models to support the evaluation of complex litigation matters.

You will be given hands-on responsibility from an early stage and gain broad exposure to securities markets, institutional investors, class action litigation, and data-driven financial analysis.

What You Will Get To Do:


Assist with the calculation and analysis of potential damages and settlement recoveries in securities class actions, including securities fraud, IPO, merger, and other shareholder litigation matters.
Collect, validate, and analyse financial, trading, market, and litigation data used in case evaluations and recovery estimates.
Conduct research on securities class actions, court filings, settlement notices, regulatory filings, and relevant market developments.
Review legal filings and settlement documentation to identify class definitions, relevant securities, eligibility requirements, and potential recovery opportunities.
Assist with research and analysis of institutional investors and prospective clients, including their investment strategies, portfolio holdings, SEC filings, assets under management, and potential exposure to litigation opportunities.
Support the development and maintenance of financial, statistical, and predictive models used to evaluate potential litigation outcomes, damages, and recoveries.
Support the preparation and maintenance of loss estimates, price-drop analyses, case valuations, and other internal and client-facing analytics.
Maintain and update internal databases and analytical tools relating to pending litigation, settlements, and institutional investors.
Prepare tables, charts, calculations, and other analytical materials using Microsoft Excel and other data-analysis tools.
Perform ad hoc financial, litigation, and business research as required.
Contribute to the continued development and improvement of research processes, analytical methodologies, databases, and internal tools.


What You Will Bring:

We are looking for a candidate with a strong analytical mindset, attention to detail, and an interest in working with financial information and complex datasets.


A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Law, or another relevant field.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Experience working with data and the ability to analyse and interpret complex datasets.
Strong research skills and the ability to collect, evaluate, and combine information from multiple sources.
Excellent attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
The ability to manage multiple assignments and priorities effectively.
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
A proactive approach, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to learn.


The following would be an advantage but is not required:


Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data-analysis or statistical software.
Experience in financial analysis, investment research, data analytics, business research, or a related area.
Familiarity with SEC filings, including Forms 13F, 13D, and 13G.
Knowledge of securities markets, institutional investment management, or financial instruments.
Experience working with large financial or transactional datasets.
An interest in securities litigation, class actions, or litigation analytics.


Why You Will Love It Here!


Flexibility: Hybrid Work Model
Your Future: Professional Development Reimbursement, including access to SS&C University
Work/Life Balance: Competitive holiday scheme
Your Wellbeing: Competitive benefits designed to support the wellbeing of our staff
Diversity & Inclusion: Committed to Welcoming, Celebrating and Thriving on Diversity
Training: Hands-On, Team-Customised throughout your career


We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds to enable us to bring diverse perspectives to our thinking and conversation. It's important to us that we strive to have a workforce that is diverse in the widest sense.

Thank you for your interest in SS&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website @ www.ssctech.com/careers.

Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Title: Senior Data Solutions Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste.

We’re more than an app: we have a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

Your mission

We are looking for a Senior Data Solutions Analyst to strengthen our use of data to inform our most business critical decisions. On a daily basis, you will be working with business leaders across operations and commercial teams to inform how they measure success, how they use data to inform strategic decisions, and ensure they have the data visibility and tools they need to make progress on those strategies every day.

Your role


Design and deliver data products within the global organization to unlock better operations workflows through automation and improved access to insights.
Generate new ideas for how to leverage the data we have to drive business performance
Provide data-driven guidance to business leaders on key strategic decisions
Elevate data literacy across the organisation, with an eye toward consistency, ease of understanding, and educating on the right way to use data in each function
Elevate the Global Analytics team by sharing best practices and learnings and offering ad-hoc guidance to other team members on their projects


Requirements


You have previous experience in an analytical role
You have a breadth of experience mapping business questions to data problems
You are motivated by improving efficiency and effectiveness through automation
You are driven by the “why” behind the work that you do, always eager to ask an extra question to make sure you’re solving for the right thing
You have experience managing multiple projects
You are passionate about data literacy
You have a proactive mindset and work well in a team environment
You are strongly proficient in SQL
You are strongly proficient in at least one BI/Data Visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, etc.)


Our values


We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We believe in a #oneteam.
We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.
We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving.
We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.


What We Have To Offer


A rare opportunity to work in an ESG-centric social impact company and certified B Corporation, where you can see real and tangible impact in your role.
Working alongside an international community of users, partners and 1,400+ colleagues across 20 countries that are on the same important sustainability mission.
Personal and professional development opportunities in a fast-paced scale-up environment.
An inclusive company culture where you can bring your authentic self to work
A strong, values-driven team culture where we celebrate successes and socialise with colleagues that care.


How to apply


We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.
Submit your CV in English.
Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV or Cover Letter will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

Title: Vil du arbejde med statistik og databehandling i Udlændingestyrelsen?
Description:
Så kom og bliv en del af vores Koncernstatistikteam og vær med til at levere statistik af høj kvalitet på et vigtigt samfundsmæssigt område.





Velkommen til din nye arbejdsplads





I Kontoret for Forretningsanalyse og Udvikling (KFU) arbejder vi blandt andet med data, analyser og initiativer inden for forretningsudvikling og sikkerhed. Opgaverne spænder fra analysearbejde på baggrund af dataindsamling på tværs af styrelsens sagsbehandling til arbejde på kontrol- og sikkerhedsområdet.





Koncernstatistik producerer og videreformidler både nyudviklet og tilbagevendende statistik for hele Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriets (UIM) område – til Folketinget, regeringen, den brede offentlighed og en række andre nationale og internationale interessenter. Vi udarbejder datagrundlaget til sagsstyring og ledelsesinformation i de forskellige myndigheder i UIMs koncern og udvikler desuden Udlændingestyrelsens egen BI løsning (Microsoft PowerBI).





“Arbejdet i Statistikteamet er præget af højt tempo og mange forskelligartede opgaver, ofte med korte frister. Det giver en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor man kommer omkring mange forskellige problemstillinger. udarbejde statistikker i bred forstand, besvare høringer fra Folketinget og forespørgsler generelt


indgå i samarbejder om at udarbejde forskellige statistikprodukter


arbejde med SQL-programmering og Excel


indgå i projekter, hvor din viden om data- og statistikmiljøet er vigtige input


have en stor kontaktflade til bl.a. ledelsen i fagkontorerne og i projektgrupper både i teamet, kontoret, og på tværs af styrelsen

har erfaring med eller talent for at arbejde med data og statistik

Title: Senior Analytiker
Description:
Motiveres du af at forbedre den strategiske økonomistyring, skabe gennemsigtighed i en organisation og lave beslutningsunderstøttende løsninger.

Så er her en spændende mulighed. Vi søger en ambitiøs kollega med stærke analytiske og tekniske evner til at understøtte strategisk styring og performance management i Jyske Bank.

Jobbet er meget alsidigt med mange gode faglige, personlige og tekniske udviklingsmuligheder.

Jobbet

Sammen med dine kolleger får du ansvar for at udvikle og styrke koncernens strategiske styring. Du kommer til at arbejde med udvikling af kundeværdikæder, performance management og analyser, der understøtter ledelsesmæssige og strategiske beslutninger.

Du trives med at arbejde analytisk og omsætte komplekse data til klare indsigter. Samtidig formår du at skabe struktur, tage ansvar og kommunikere tydeligt med interessenter på tværs af organisationen.

Databearbejdning og performance management er centrale elementer i jobbet, og du vil arbejde med flere tekniske værktøjer. Derfor er stærke tekniske kompetencer en vigtig forudsætning.

Rollen giver en bred kontaktflade i koncernen, og du får et tæt samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af forretningsområder og organisatoriske niveauer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:



Udvikling af bankens centrale kundeværdikæder
Udarbejdelse af analyser og beslutningsgrundlag til ledelse og forretning
Projektarbejde og deltagelse i udviklingsinitiativer på tværs af koncernen
Strukturering, bearbejdning og analyse af komplekse datamængder
Sparring og kommunikation med interessenter på tværs af organisationen
Arbejde med dataværktøjer som SAS Studio, SQL og lignende teknologier
Bidrage til udvikling og implementering af AI-løsninger i arbejdsgange og processer



Afdelingen

Business Finance er en del af Økonomi og arbejdssted er Silkeborg. Vi har som ambition at gøre forretningen klogere på økonomi, risiko og prissætning og har ansvaret for at give det økonomiske beslutningsgrundlag for strategiske og forretningsmæssige beslutninger på alle niveauer i koncernen.

Afdelingens fokus dækker bredt fra koncerndirektionen til den enkelte medarbejder.

I afdelingen er vi pt. 12 medarbejdere. Vi har en åben og uhøjtidelig omgangstone, hvor højt humør, samarbejde og fagligt engagement er en vigtig del af vores hverdag.

Din profil

Vi forventer, at du har en relevant uddannelse på kandidatniveau eller anden relevant erfaring og kompetence og har erfaringer fra lignende jobs.

Vi forestiller os desuden, at du:



har gode samarbejdsevner, så du ubesværet skaber gode relationer
kan arbejde selvstændigt, er vedholdende og god til at håndtere mange bolde i luften
er fagligt nysgerrig overfor ny viden og nye vinkler på tingene, og ikke bange for at gå uprøvede veje og at tænke ”ud af boksen”
har et stort drive og er i stand til at balancere hastighed og kvalitet
har erfaring med at arbejde med store datamængder, kendskab til SAS vil være en fordel
har stærke analytiske evner og mod på at sætte dig ind i komplekse områder



Jobbet er bredt og giver dermed god mulighed for at tilpasse de konkrete opgaver til din profil og erfaring.

Ansøgning

I Jyske Bank mener vi, at diversitet skaber bedre beslutninger og relationer samt et mere dynamisk arbejdsmiljø. Vi arbejder aktivt for inklusion og lige muligheder og opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge.

Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning snarest muligt og senest den 29. oktober 2026.

HR Rekrutteringspartner, Line Elkær Poulsen, vil tage sig af din ansøgning i samarbejde med Afdelingsdirektør, Louise Julsgaard Rasmussen. Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Title: Bliv senioranalytiker til Operations i en foreningsejet Nykredit-koncern
Place: Taastrup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle en af Nykredit-koncernens største driftsorganisationer?

Operations er en forretningskritisk enhed, der hver dag sikrer stabile leverancer til kunder, rådgivere og samarbejdspartnere. Vi søger en erfaren senioranalytiker, der brænder for at omsætte data til handling og skabe konkrete forbedringer i den daglige drift.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en central sparringspartner for ledelsen og får ansvar for at skabe indsigt i performance, identificere forbedringsmuligheder og drive analyser, der styrker både kundeoplevelse, kvalitet og effektivitet.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter bl.a. at:


drive analyser af driftsdata, kapacitet, produktivitet, kvalitet og gennemløbstider,
udarbejde ledelsesinformation, KPI'er og dashboards, der understøtter beslutninger på alle niveauer,
identificere flaskehalse, fejlårsager og forbedringsmuligheder på tværs af processer,
understøtte implementering af forbedringsinitiativer og automatisering,
udarbejde business cases og følge op på gevinster,
samarbejde tæt med ledere, specialister og udviklingsfunktioner om operationelle forbedringer,
skabe gennemsigtighed omkring leverancesikkerhed, risici og kapacitetsudfordringer,
bidrage til etablering af en solid datadrevet forbedringskultur i Operations.



Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for økonomi, data, matematik, engineering, LEAN eller lignende.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:


arbejder effektivt og resultatorienteret,
har solide kompetencer inden for dataanalyse og behersker værktøjer som Excel, Power BI og SQL,
kan omsætte komplekse data til klare budskaber og anbefalinger,
arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt,
har erfaring med LEAN, procesoptimering eller operational excellence,
trives i krydsfeltet mellem strategi, analyse og daglig drift,
er en dygtig kommunikator, der kan udfordre og sparre med ledere på alle niveauer,
kan understøtte og udvikle organisationens brug af AI til analyse- og optimeringsopgaver.



Til gengæld lover vi udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.

Dit nye team

Du vil referere til den øverste leder for Operations. Operations er Nykredit-koncernens centrale enhed, der varetager administrations- og produktionsopgaver på bank-, pensions- og realkreditområdet. Vi varetager endvidere en lang række opgaver inden for likviditet, betalinger, depot og investeringer. Derudover yder vi faglig support til kolleger i hele koncernen.

Hos os får du mulighed for at sætte et markant aftryk på udviklingen af en stor driftsorganisation. Du kommer tæt på forretningen og den øverste ledelse, og du får mulighed for at arbejde med komplekse problemstillinger og spille central rolle i at skabe fremtidens Operations.

Vi tilbyder et arbejdsmiljø med høje ambitioner, korte beslutningsveje og dygtige kolleger, der brænder for at skabe værdi for kunderne gennem stabile og effektive processer. Vi glæder os til at tage godt imod dig som vores nye kollega.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte vicedirektør Allan Rømer på telefon 30 66 96 25, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

Har du spørgsmål til rekrutteringsprocessen, kan du kontakte rekrutteringsteamet på nytjob@nykredit.dk

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV. Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler.

Title: Data Analyst / Biostatistician – Danish Blood Donor Study (DBDS) Department of Clinical Immunology, Aarhus University Hospital
Description:
Data Analyst / Biostatistician – Danish Blood Donor Study (DBDS) Department of Clinical Immunology, Aarhus University Hospital,

We are seeking a data analyst with strong statistical and data analytical skills to join the Danish Blood Donor Study (DBDS). The ideal candidate enjoys working with large, complex datasets and is also interested in the biological and clinical questions behind the data.

What We Offer

DBDS is a national research project built on one of the world's largest biobanks, with more than 180,000 participants and over 3 million plasma samples. The study combines laboratory and registry data with phenotype data collected through, for example, questionnaires. Our research covers a wide range of topics, including how genetic factors and plasma biomarkers can predict disease. DBDS is a unique cohort because of its granular longitudinal data and blood samples, which allow us to study biomarker change over time.

The position offers an exceptional opportunity to work with large, complex datasets in a research environment where data analysis is closely integrated with clinical and biological research. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team and apply your analytical skills to research with the potential to improve public health.

The Department of Clinical Immunology (Blodbank og Immunologi) at Aarhus University Hospital is Central Denmark Region's specialist department for clinical immunology. The department has approximately 220 employees and is responsible for producing blood components; laboratory testing, diagnostic investigations and advisory services in transfusion medicine and transplant immunology; HIV and hepatitis testing; autoimmune diagnostics; and the investigation of immunodeficiencies.

Job Description

As a data analyst in DBDS, you will analyse large, complex longitudinal datasets based on registry, questionnaire and biomarker data. You will contribute to research projects across DBDS and help translate research questions into robust analyses and meaningful results.

You will plan and conduct statistical analyses and select methods suited to each research question. You will collaborate closely with researchers, data managers and statisticians within the department and across the national DBDS network, where you will advise researchers on statistical methods and help them plan and interpret their analyses.

You will also contribute to the day-to-day operation of DBDS, including occasional data management and data quality tasks as needed.

Your profile

Ideally, you have a background in statistics, biostatistics, bioinformatics, mathematics, data science or a related field. You have strong skills in advanced data analysis, in developing and applying AI and machine learning methods, or both. What matters most is a solid understanding of statistical principles and the ability to select, apply and critically assess the methods best suited to each research question and dataset. A PhD or equivalent experience is preferred.

It is important to us that you


have experience handling and analysing large longitudinal datasets
have strong skills in R, Python or similar for data analysis and processing
have a solid understanding of statistical methods and can select appropriate models for each research question
have experience with, or an interest in, registry data and/or biomarker data
can plan and carry out analyses independently
can interpret data and communicate results clearly and precisely
understand, or are keen to learn about, the biological and clinical questions behind the analyses
work in a structured way and can manage several tasks at once
collaborate effectively and thrive in interdisciplinary settings
have strong communication skills in English.


Experience with epidemiological or population-based studies, or with biobank data, is an advantage.

Employment details

The position is based at the Department of Clinical Immunology, Aarhus University Hospital, in the research group led by Clinical Chair Professor and Chief Physician Christian Erikstrup.

This is a three-year fixed-term position with the possibility of extension. The position is intended to be full-time. The start date is January 1st 2027 or by agreement.

Salary and terms of employment

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement in Central Denmark Region. Employment is conditional upon a satisfactory child-related record check.

Application and contact

Applications may be written in Danish or English and must be received no later than November 8th 2026.

Interviews are expected to be held shortly thereafter. For further information about the position, please contact Clinical Chair Professor and Chief Physician Christian Erikstrup per mail christian.erikstrup@skejby.rm.dk.

The postion is primarly a full-time position.

Employees undergoing redeployment who apply for the position have priority in accordance with the applicable rules.

Under the EU Pay Transparency Directive, which took effect on June 7th 2026, Central Denmark Region is required to inform you of the starting salary, or the starting salary range, for a position before you are offered employment.

Central Denmark Region's salary catalogue for most staff groups and positions in the region is available here (in Danish): Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse – Medarbejder.rm.dk

Title: Nordic Data & Analytics Specialist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Locations: Stockholm | Copenhagen V | Oslo | Helsinki

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a hands-on Nordic Data & Analytics Specialist to join our Nordic People Analytics function, within Strategic Projects & Analytics, supporting our four Nordic markets.

This role focuses on understanding our data landscape, extracting and transforming relevant data, building visualizations and dashboards, and delivering ad hoc analyses that help our leadership, People teams and key stakeholders gain sharper insights from data and make better decisions. A smaller part of your role will be to help functions experiment and adopt AI tools to work more effectively and future-proof.

Key Responsibilities


Develop a deep understanding of our data landscape – including datasets, how they connect, their purposes, information flows, and how it relates to actual business processes.
Explore and quality-test our data in Snowflake, using SQL to validate fields, reconcile numbers, investigate data issues – and confirm / align with the functions owning the data and processes.
Build and maintain reliable data pipelines at consumption / transformation layer, e.g. by extracting, transforming and validating Snowflake data for new Tableau dashboards.
Design, build and continuously improve Tableau / BI dashboards that are used across Nordics.
Translate stakeholder questions into concrete data needs and insightful analyses across markets and topics, e.g. headcount, hiring, attrition, engagement and much more.
Act as the go-to technical contact for colleagues who need data support, and help them explore and prototype AI tools like Claude and Agents to keep functions at the forefront.


What You'll Bring

You are likely someone who combines strong technical skills with analytical curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a drive to improve how things work. You enjoy getting into details, understanding how data connects and flows, solving problems alone and with others, and enabling the organization through data and analytics, while staying at the forefront by developing yourself and others.

Core Skills And Competencies


Structured Analytics and Technical Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to structure problems, investigate data, understand how it relates, and develop practical solutions.
Curiosity and Learning Agility: Genuine interest in understanding how things work, questioning assumptions, exploring new technologies and continuously improving.
Ownership and Execution: Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines and plans.
Accuracy and Attention to Detail: You take pride in data quality, consistency and building solutions others can trust, with ability to explain and stand behind work and results.
Stakeholder Focus: Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into useful, practical analytics solutions, working closely with stakeholders. Able to communicate findings clearly in meetings, presentations, dashboards and written communication.
Business Understanding: Ability connect data and analytics to underlying business processes, understand what drives the numbers and identify opportunities for improvement.


Qualifications And Experience


Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data, Engineering, Computer Science, Software Development; also considering Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or related fields.
Experience: Recent graduate or up to 3 years of experience in analytics, data (engineering), or a related field.
Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of SQL and comfort learning Snowflake; Excel; hands-on experience with data, Tableau, Tableau Prep, BI tools, and AI is advantageous.
Languages: Fluent in English; proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage


Above all, we value strong technical foundations, analytical curiosity, ownership, and potential over experience with specific tools or technologies.

Who You'll Work With

You will join our Nordic Analytics team, working primarily within People Analytics in our People organization, and collaborating closely with Business Analytics in our Finance organization. Together, we support data, analytics, dashboards and AI adoption across our four Nordic markets: Sweden, Finland, Norway and Denmark.

The role is based in one of our Nordic capitals, preferably Stockholm.

You will be part of a collaborative team that values curiosity, knowledge sharing and continuous learning. We actively support each other’s development, and you will receive guidance, mentoring and opportunities to grow your technical skills and responsibilities over time.

Additional info

We offer 


Attractive and performance-based compensation package with fixed and variable components
Market competitive pension package
Comprehensive insurance package, including private medical insurance
Flexible Work & Work life balance  
30 days of vacation
Sports and activities e.g. Yoga, PT sessions, football, tennis 
Wide variety of social office events  
Social networks – Colorful@BCG, Pride@BCG, Family@BCG, AccessAbility@bCG and International Cohort  


How to apply   

Please submit your application by attaching your CV, including few lines on motivation for role, through our BCG Career website by 27 of October. We process all applications we receive and screen them continuously during the application period. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided accommodation to participate in the job application and interview process.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

Title: Data Analyst
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Department: Complaint Projects & Digital Products, Enterprise IT & Quality

Location: Bagsværd, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As AI & PowerBI Developer, you will bring AI and PowerBI into the daily work of the business. You will design, build and maintain analytics and automation that turn real business needs into clear insights and more efficient processes. Working hands-on with data and close to the people who use your work, you will introduce new AI technologies, help colleagues make informed, data-driven decisions and gain broad exposure to Novo Nordisk’s product portfolio.

What You’ll Bring

You are self-sufficient and enjoy creating and driving data-centric projects. You’ll bring:


An MSc in IT, Data Analytics, Software Engineering or a related field.
At least 2 years of relevant experience.
Proven experience with Python, SQL and PowerBI development.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to share technical knowledge with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
A collaborative mindset and openness to working with colleagues from diverse backgrounds.
Flexibility and adaptability, with the ability to quickly learn and apply new technologies.


Useful, But Not Essential


Familiarity with using AI for development, such as MCPs, skills and context engineering.


What You’ll Do

You will work hands-on with data to design, build and maintain BI and AI solutions that support daily business. Close partnership with end users and management will shape how you understand needs, test what you build and keep refining it.


Build, deploy and maintain efficient, intuitive BI and AI solutions in line with quality standards.
Manage existing PowerBI and generative-AI solutions to keep them performing at their best.
Take ownership of opportunities to improve process efficiency through AI or BI automation.
Follow developments in the AI space and bring new technology into your solutions where it adds value.
Listen to the business, identify needs, visualise data and support data-driven processes and decision-making.
Navigate complex business domains and organisational structures to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping them get real value from business intelligence and AI.


Who You’ll Work With

In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the Novo Nordisk value chain, staying close to stakeholders and helping deliver trusted technology, high quality and responsible ways of working.

You will join the Complaint Projects & Digital Products team, which supports the business in executing strategic projects and implementing digital products. Your role stands out because you will introduce new technologies, including AI, and make sure the team has the assets it needs to produce valuable insights and support informed, data-driven decisions.

You will report to the Associate Director of Complaint Projects & Digital Products, based in Bagsværd, and work closely with managers and colleagues across departments. Your closest partners will be the end users and management who rely on your work, and together you will move quickly from identifying a need to testing and refining what works.

What You Can Expect Here

You will gain broad exposure to Novo Nordisk’s product portfolio and work with diverse stakeholders across the organisation. You will have room to bring forward new AI technologies, make your voice heard and contribute your expertise to how the business uses data.

You will be trusted to take ownership of your work and supported to grow as you learn and apply new technologies on the job. As Novo Nordisk upskills its workforce to advance AI as a main driver for innovation, you will be part of putting that ambition into practice, day to day.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn data and AI into progress the business can use every day, apply for the AI & PowerBI Developer role by 23 October 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact acur@novonordisk.com

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Title: Lead Product Data Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Tech-first. Ego-free. User-obsessed.

Over one million Danes use Skatteguiden to understand and optimise their taxes. We automate tax tracking, surface deductions people didn't know they had, and give users the insights they need to make better financial decisions — all directly connected to the Danish tax authority.

We're an independent company of around 50 people based in Copenhagen, with a 4.7-star rating and a simple mission: make financial insight accessible to everyone, not just those who can afford an accountant.

The role

We need someone who owns product analytics — not just executes it. You'll set the direction for how Skatteguiden uses data to understand its users and make product decisions, and you'll be the person who raises the bar for what good analytics looks like here.

You'll work closely with product managers across our product teams and have real influence on what gets built and why. This isn't a support function. It's a lead role with ownership.

What you'll be working on


Own the product analytics function — define the strategy, set the standards, and drive adoption across product teams.
Define and maintain core product metrics and KPIs across the organisation.

Title: Reporting and Analytics, Associate, Copenhagen
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you our next Reporting and Analytics Associate, turning data into insights across Urban Partners' investments and funds?

About The Role

We are looking for a Reporting and Analytics Associate to join our Reporting & Analytics team in Copenhagen. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working hands-on with data, reporting, and analysis, and who wants to develop within a dynamic investment and real estate environment.

You will play an important role in ensuring that data and reporting across our investments and funds is accurate, transparent, and insightful. Working with both financial and non-financial performance data, you will help support decision-making across Urban Partners while contributing to the continued development and optimisation of reporting processes.

You will gain broad exposure to investor reporting, fund reporting, sustainability reporting, and performance analytics across multiple investment strategies, funds, and markets. This provides a unique opportunity to develop both technical reporting capabilities and a strong understanding of how data supports investment decision-making.

The Reporting & Analytics team is part of Finance & Group Support and works closely with colleagues across Finance, Investor Relations, Sustainability, and Digital. The team is responsible for delivering analyses and reporting to both internal and external stakeholders while continuously improving data quality, automation, and reporting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities


Support financial and non-financial reporting across investments and funds.
Contribute to data quality, governance, and reporting consistency.
Assist in developing and maintaining reporting data models, cubes, and analytical tools that support scalable reporting and decision-making.
Support reporting optimisation, automation initiatives, and AI-enabled reporting processes to improve efficiency and reporting quality.
Act as a trusted business partner to Investor Relations, Finance, Sustainability, and Investment teams, helping translate business needs into data-driven reporting and decision support.


Your Experience & Skills

We are looking for a colleague with approximately 2-3 years of professional experience who enjoys working close to the numbers and understands the value of reliable data and high-quality reporting.


Degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field
Experience from a hands-on finance-related role such as Financial Controller, Finance Analyst, Reporting Analyst, Accountant, Finance Business Partner, or similar
Strong Excel skills and experience working directly with reporting, reconciliations, analyses, and large datasets
Experience supporting reporting cycles, month-end activities, management reporting, or financial analysis
Interest in technology, automation, AI, and process optimisation
Excellent English skills
Digital skills and tool proficiency (e.g. SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Excel, data structures, and data cubes)


It would be an advantage to have experience from investment management, real estate, asset management, private equity, fund structures or similar fields.

Your Character

As a person, you are motivated by learning, curious by nature, and enjoy taking ownership of your work.

You Are


Comfortable rolling up your sleeves and working directly with data, details, and reporting material.
Detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work
Analytical and structured, with a strong attention to accuracy
Curious and eager to continuously learn and develop
Collaborative and relationship-oriented, with a positive mindset
Motivated by contributing both professionally and socially to the team


What We Offer


Make a difference by helping create urban spaces and places that enrich people’s lives in the most sustainable way.
Lead the industry with an innovator that is pioneering new approaches while raising standards and inspiring the industry.
Learn and grow as part of a powerhouse of brilliant people where teamwork, feedback, and different ways of thinking are at the core.
Be your whole self in a purpose-driven culture with a strong sense of belonging, based on trust, celebration, and caring for each other.


In addition, you will gain broad exposure across multiple funds, countries, and business areas, giving you a unique opportunity to build both your finance expertise and your understanding of how reporting supports investment decision-making at scale.

About Us

Urban Partners is a visionary urban investment platform. We invest in, develop, and manage real assets and companies driving urban development, with the ambition of improving the way people live, work, and interact in cities. Through our investment strategies, we combine financial performance with long-term value creation and responsible urban development.

Apply 

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would love to hear from you. Please attach your CV in English, your most recent academic transcript and answer our screening questions when applying using the apply link below. 

If you have any questions, please contact our recruiter, Sarah Midtgaard Meyer, at samey@urban.partners  

Applications are reviewed, and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible and no later than the 25th of October.

Title: Operations Analyst, Grenaa
Description:
Would you like to play a meaningful role in transforming data into insights that drive operational excellence? In this role, you will analyze operational performance, optimize processes, and support strategic decision-making across the organization. Come and join us!

We are facing an exciting future with considerable growth and demanding changes. We continue to evolve our advanced technologies and mission critical solutions for the defense and aerospace industry to deliver real-world solutions that matter to the security of people on land, at sea and in the air. Therefore, we are looking for an Operations Analyst to become part of this journey and contribute to our overall purpose – securing people through advanced technology.

Your role as part of the team

As our new Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in turning operational data into valuable insights that support decision-making and continuous improvement across our organization. You will help identify opportunities to optimize processes, improve resource utilization, and enhance operational performance through a data-driven approach.

In our team we take pride in developing people and technology. You will become part of our Planning & Analytics team, currently consisting of nine colleagues with overall responsibility for the production planning process in Terma Aerostructures. The team is diverse in age, gender, and nationality, and we take pride in developing people and technology through close collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mutual support. We work in an informal environment with strong cooperation across departments and production, where different perspectives are valued and encouraged. We care about the work we do and the people behind it.

Technical skills matter, but your mindset matters even more. We imagine that you are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex challenges. You enjoy working with data, collaborating with stakeholders, and translating insights into meaningful improvements. Sounds like you? Then you could be a great addition to our team.

How you will make a meaningful contribution

In this role, you will contribute to a range of tasks across your area of responsibility. Your key responsibilities include:


Collect, analyze, and interpret operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across operations and production planning
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, KPIs, and data visualizations that support decision-making across departments
Collaborate with stakeholders to optimize processes, improve resource utilization, streamline workflows, and support operational excellence initiatives
Conduct root-cause analyses of operational challenges and provide actionable recommendations to improve performance and resolve bottlenecks
Support the implementation of new tools, technologies, and processes while delivering insights and recommendations to leadership on strategic operational initiatives.




Bring your expertise into play

To thrive in this role, we imagine that you bring some of the following qualifications:


A degree in Business Analytics, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
Experience working with data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Python, Excel, SQL, or similar technologies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with the ability to work with large and complex datasets
The ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders with different backgrounds and areas of expertise
Experience with ERP systems is an advantage but not a requirement.


Whether you are a recent graduate eager to begin your career or an experienced professional looking for your next challenge, we encourage you to apply. We believe diverse experiences add value to our team and organization.

As we are an international organization, it is important that you are fluent in English both in writing and verbal at a professional level. Danish is an advantage but not a requirement.

Please note that this position requires a minimum of four working days per week on-site in Grenaa.

Let’s secure people through advanced technology

We believe that different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds make us stronger. We are committed to creating a more diverse and balanced workplace that reflects the talent and perspectives around us. By creating an inclusive environment with equal opportunities to contribute, grow, and succeed, we aim to broaden our talent pool and strengthen our teams for the future. We want everyone to feel welcome, valued, and confident in pursuing their ambitions at Terma.

When joining Terma, we promise that you will experience great people, challenging tasks, and the opportunity to make an impact. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and knowledge sharing, where learning is embedded in everyday work and supported by colleagues across all career stages.

Benefits

International Environment: Explore great teamwork and professional sparring with colleagues around the world.
Comprehensive Benefits Package: Receive a 10% paid pension along with a beneficial health care and insurance package and paid internet connection at home. Enjoy discounts from various business partners.
Well-being Perks: Opportunity to enroll in our on-site massage-offer at our locations in Denmark.
Social and Professional Events: We have an active staff association that arranges a variety of social activities and events to bring all of our colleagues together.

Career Paths: Opportunities to grow your career in a direction that suits you, whether you prefer a specialist path or a leadership role.

We are all Terma - diverse in skills and equal in value. That is why we encourage all individuals to apply and are committed to ensuring that every employee has equal opportunities to succeed and feel respected and valued within our organization. To support an unbiased evaluation process, we kindly encourage applicants to omit personal details such as photos and age from their applications.

If you would like to take on the challenge of working in an innovative company, we look forward to receiving your application. A resume is required, while a cover letter is optional. To ensure that your application will reach us and is properly processed, we only accept applications via www.terma.com. Applications will be processed continuously.

Do you have any questions regarding the position?

Feel free to contact Hiring Manager on e-mail: dako@terma.com

Bear in mind, that we need you to confirm that you can obtain a security clearance by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service, and that all adults in your household are not posing any risk to the related risk-evaluation. This entails among other issues:


That you have as a minimum stayed within NATO/EU/MISWG countries for the last 7 years only interrupted by short stays abroad, meaning less than 6 months, and
That you have not committed serious criminal offences

Title: Student BI Specialist til Nordens største markedsplads for booking af fester, møder og konferencer
Place: Aarhus Municipality, Central Denmark Region, Denmark
Description:
Brænder du for at knuse data og omsætte det til forretningsindsigt? Har du en analytisk værktøjskasse i topform og en stærk forretningsforståelse? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!




Om Evarto

Evarto er Nordens største markedsplads for fester, møder og konferencer. Vi blev etableret i 2020 og samarbejder i dag med mere end 1.500 selskabs- og mødesteder fordelt i Danmark, Norge og Sverige.




Om jobbet

Som vores nye BI-specialist vil du spille en central rolle i at drive vækst, konvertering og kundeoplevelser fremad – alt sammen baseret på data. Du bliver en nøgleperson i vores forretningsudvikling og vil arbejde tæt sammen med både ledelsen, marketing, customer success og produktteamet.




Dine primære opgaver bliver bl.a.:

Udvikle statistiske modeller til analyse og forecast af interne forretningsdata
Opsøge forretningsmuligheder i data og selvstændigt drive dem videre som initiativer eller projekter
Levere forretningsindsigter til alle teams i organisationen
Understøtte strategiske beslutninger med analyser og præsentationer
Identificere trends og mønstre i brugeradfærd, konvertering, kundeengagement og meget mere
Automatisere og effektivisere processer




Vi forestiller os, at du:

Læser eller har læst en relevant uddannelse, fx en kandidat i Business Intelligence eller Datavidenskab
Tænker AI first og har god erfaring med at bruge forskellige AI-agenter i dine arbejdsgange
Er vant til at arbejde tæt på forretningen og har en skarp forretningsforståelse
Trives i en selvstændig rolle med stor frihed og ansvar. Du skal selv komme med idéer og udføre dem
Har en struktureret tilgang og elsker at finde mønstre, muligheder og løsninger gennem data




Vi tilbyder:

En nøgleposition i en ambitiøs og hurtigvoksende scale-up med direkte reference til virksomhedens ledelse
Mulighed for at sætte dine egne aftryk på, hvordan vi arbejder med data
Et ungt og energisk team med flad struktur
Konkurrencedygtig fast løn
Sociale arrangementer, bordtennis i pausen og god frokostordning
Kontor i cykelafstand fra Aarhus C




Er du klar til at tage næste skridt med os?




Send dit CV og en kort, motiveret ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet det rette match.




﻿Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Bruun på tlf. 26 25 43 51 eller mail: jfb@evarto.dk.

Collect, consolidate, and analyze business data related to sales performance, vehicle deliveries, dealer network performance, inventory, market trends, and other key operational indicators.

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Statistics, Data Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret business data and translate findings into practical recommendations.

Good understanding of business performance indicators, reporting processes, and operational planning.
Excellent communication skills in English and Danish.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks while maintaining data accuracy and meeting deadlines.
Proactive, structured, and results-oriented, with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams.
Adaptable and comfortable working in a developing business environment where processes and responsibilities may evolve.
Interest in the automotive industry, electric mobility, and international business operations.


Our Offer


A competitive remuneration package based on experience and qualifications.
The opportunity to contribute to the development of BYD's business operations in Denmark and potentially across the Nordic region.
An international working environment with close collaboration across local and European teams.
The opportunity to work closely with business leaders and contribute to data-driven decision-making in a growing automotive organization.

Title: DD&IT Associate Performance Manager - turn data into strategic insights
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to help leaders make better decisions by turning performance data into clear, actionable insights? And are you ready to take ownership of defined analyses, reporting products and improvement initiatives?

Then this is your chance to develop your expertise in Digital, Data and IT (DD&IT) performance management and analytics, with room to grow into an influential performance and insights role – all while working at a company dedicated to making life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs.

Join the department that connects performance and strategy

You will join our Strategy, Performance and Portfolio department within DD&IT, based in Humlebæk.

Here, you will work at the intersection of strategy execution, performance management and operational improvement. Working closely with leaders, finance -and data specialists, you will help improve how we measure, understand and communicate performance across DD&IT.

Connect the dots between strategy and results

Your work will range from translating leadership questions into meaningful KPIs to developing sustainable reporting solutions. By connecting operational, financial, portfolio and strategy execution perspectives, you will help create transparency, identify opportunities for improvement and provide decision-ready insights that support our strategic priorities.

Over time, you will also contribute to establishing a consistent and trusted performance management approach that helps DD&IT focus resources and investments where they create the most value.

More specifically, you will:


turn strategic priorities into analytical requirements and actionable performance measures aligned across stakeholders
conduct analyses and deep dives to uncover trends, risks, root causes and improvement opportunities, translating findings into clear recommendations for leadership
design, maintain and continuously improve dashboards and reporting products that make complex performance data accessible and easy to interpret
define reporting requirements and work with data owners and specialists to ensure reliable, consistent and sustainable reporting
prepare insights for performance reviews and leadership discussions, facilitate conversations about metrics and improvement opportunities, and use data storytelling to communicate complex findings clearly




You combine analytical thinking with business curiosity

We do not expect you to be an expert in every technical discipline as long as you are curious and proactive. What matters is that you can translate ambiguous reporting needs into clear project scopes and delivering performance reporting that enable data-driven decision making.

In addition, we imagine that you:


hold a master's degree in business, economics, finance, strategy, engineering, data or a related field
have relevant analytical experience from a graduate role, internship, consultancy project or similar environment, ideally involving digital, data & IT performance data
have experience identifying patterns in data, drawing conclusions and communicating clear recommendations
have experience with Power BI, Power Query/M and DAX, along with an understanding of data modelling concepts and reporting structures such as star schemas and semantic models
understand data quality, governance, reporting standards and performance measurement principles.




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the role please reach out to Head of Strategy Performance & PMO.

We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Title: Product Data Insights Lead
Description:
Product Data Insights Lead




Ballerup, DK, 2750




At KMD, we build digital solutions used by millions of people around the world. These solutions are the digital foundations of our most important institutions, from governments and public services to financial industries and private companies. Our mission is to ensure that they are reliable, accessible, and efficient.




We believe that the future is what you make it. So a career at KMD is a career with purpose and freedom. One where you’ll have a direct hand in improving the lives of people, while being empowered with the resources and autonomy to shape the course of your own professional journey.

Do you want to turn complex insights into software that makes a real difference to millions of citizens?

Do you have a background in data research and a sharp analytical mind? Can you turn customer research, usage data and competitive signals into evidence that helps product managers act on the right thing at the right time, whether that's a new product or an improvement to an existing one? Then this could be your next role at KMD.




About the role




As Product Data Insights Lead, you carve out the data that matters from the noise around it e.g. customer research, usage patterns, customer feedback, value-hypothesis tests, and competitive and market signals and turn it into clear reports and tools that Product Managers can act on.

At its core, the job is analytical: you build the data foundation that shows how people really use KMD's products, where they get stuck and what to build or improve next. You decide what counts as solid evidence and make sure it reaches the right people, in the right shape, at the right time.

This is a hands-on role in our product portfolio governance team, where you'll work closely with product, tech and commercial leaders to make things happen.




Your tasks




Provide evidence-based input to product decisions by combining customer research, usage analytics, churn drivers and value-hypothesis testing, for both new product opportunities and improvements to existing ones
Identify usability issues, friction points and bottlenecks in the user journey, and surface them to product management with enough clarity and timing to act on
Turn validated insights into practical input for the roadmap
Own the metrics for usage, adoption and churn • Bring AI and new ways of working with product data insights to sharpen our understanding of users and set the standard for how PMs use it
Build scalable dashboards and reports together with the data team What you bring • Strong SQL and data modelling skills (e.g. star schemas) to build clean, reusable datasets
Hands-on experience extracting, transforming and loading data into Power BI (Power Query, DAX)
Solid statistical skills and an eye for the usability problems hiding in the data, not just the numbers
Experience combining user insight (feedback, interviews) with usage data
Experience building AI agents or LLM workflows, good judgement on when to trust the output, and the drive to bring this into how product management works
3-4 years of experience working with Saas products will be an advantage




What we offer




A central role in helping KMD's product teams spot the right opportunities at the right time with real impact on how we understand and use data and insight across product
Close collaboration with product management and senior stakeholders across the organisation
Flexible working conditions and a healthy focus on work-life balance




Interested?




We interview candidates on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply.

Questions about the role? Reach out to Morten Sunesen, Head of Product Portfolio and Governance, at mfo@kmd.dk







KMD (an NEC company) is committed to providing equal opportunities. Hence, we invite all qualified interested applicants to apply for career opportunities. At KMD all aspects of employment and cooperation including the decision to hire/cooperate with will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other status protected under local anti-discrimination legislation.

Title: Data Specialist - 12 Month FTC
Place: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

As our Data Specialist, you'll help collect, validate, manage and analyse commercial data, transforming information into actionable insights that support business growth. You'll work across data ingestion, data quality and reporting activities, partnering with stakeholders to ensure the right data is available to the right people at the right time. This is a replacement role on a fixed-term maternity cover contract.

Required Qualifications



Managed data ingestion processes and maintained reliable data flows.
Performed data quality reviews, validation activities and issue resolution on customer or sales datasets.
Generated commercial data quality insights that supported business decision-making and growth.
Translated sales or commercial data into clear recommendations for business stakeholders.
Worked closely with commercial teams and cross-functional partners to deliver data-driven outcomes.


Preferred Qualifications



You have strong collaboration skills and want to join an international working environment.
You are curious about the business, have an affinity for data, and are energized to review the status quo and actively support improvements.
You have analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite herein Excel and experience with SQL and/or Python for data analysis and reporting
Partnered with stakeholders across multiple business units or regions.


What You'll Build



Reliable data ingestion and validation processes.
High-quality commercial datasets that support reporting and analysis.
Clear insights that help teams understand performance and identify opportunities.
Strong partnerships between data teams, commercial teams and business stakeholders.
Scalable reporting approaches that improve decision-making and confidence in data.


If you've worked in a role where you managed commercial data, maintained data quality and produced meaningful business insights, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to turn data into action, communicate clearly with stakeholders and deliver dependable results through strong analytical thinking.

Life on the team

You'll join a team that works closely together, sharing knowledge and supporting one another to solve data challenges. We're looking for someone who enjoys exploring data, is curious about how the business works and takes satisfaction in finding patterns, trends and opportunities. You'll thrive if you enjoy learning, asking questions and helping others build confidence in data.

What Success Looks Like

Success means becoming a trusted partner for commercial stakeholders, ensuring data quality remains high and providing insights that help shape decisions. Over time, you'll contribute to the team's evolving priorities and future initiatives while working closely with commercial teams and cross-functional colleagues. You'll be recognised for reliable delivery, constructive collaboration and the quality of the insights you provide.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Your workplace Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert.

Hybrid Working Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team.

Title: Konsulent til Dataenheden på Herlev og Gentofte Hospital
Place: Gentofte, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Herlev og Gentofte Hospital søger en konsulent til Dataenheden, der vil være med til at styrke vores arbejde med ledelsesinformation samt aktivitets- og kapacitetsanalyser.





Dataenheden er en del af Økonomiafdelingen og består af otte dygtige og erfarne kollegaer. Vi leverer analyser og indsigter til hospitalets kliniske afdelinger og direktion og bidrager til at skabe overblik over aktivitet, kapacitet og udvikling på tværs af et af Danmarks største hospitaler.





Udover Dataenheden består Økonomiafdelingen af en Budgetenhed og en Planlægningsenhed med i alt 44 ansatte.





Stillingens indhold





Som konsulent i Dataenheden bidrager du til, at hospitalets ledelse og kliniske afdelinger træffer beslutninger på et solidt datagrundlag om aktivitet, kapacitet og ressourceanvendelse. Du arbejder med analyser af aktivitet, patientforløb og kapacitetsudnyttelse og omsætter data til beslutningsstøtte og konkrete indsigter. Opgaverne spænder fra idéudvikling og databehandling til formidling og implementering, og omfatter også udvikling af datamodeller i Region Hovedstadens data- og analyseplatform. Betjening af 3-4 kliniske afdelinger vedrørende aktivitets- og ressourcespørgsmål


Modeludvikling og databearbejdning i Data- og analyseplatformen


Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af hospitalets ledelsesinformation


Aktivitets- og ressourcestyring


Kapacitetsanalyser og analyser ved ændringer i hospitalsaktiviteten


Samarbejde på tværs af stabene

Besidder en veludviklet analytisk sans og kan håndtere komplekse data



 






Har erfaring med analyseværktøjer som fx Power BI, SQL, SAS eller lignende


Kan medvirke til fagligt at udvikle enhedens opgaveløsninger


Kan bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø

Title: Commercial Excellence Analyst I, Senior
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Commercial Excellence Analyst

PPG is a global coatings company with operations in over 70 countries and more than 180 years of industry leadership. As part of its Architectural Coatings EMEA division, PPG is executing a significant commercial transformation across all markets, and the Danish market is a key part of that journey.

This role is central to making that transformation happen on the ground while contributing to a regional agenda that reaches well beyond Denmark. For the right candidate, it offers a rare combination of local impact, regional visibility, and the opportunity to develop cross-functional expertise across commercial strategy, data analytics, and change leadership from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Excellence & Sales Transformation


Coordinate and drive the implementation of PPG's sales transformation framework across the Danish market, covering seven key streams: sales talent, sales training, sales leadership, Salesforce CRM pipeline management, operating cadence, customer relationship management, and sales enablement.
Act as the bridge between global strategy and local execution, ensuring that regional priorities are adapted and embedded effectively within the local organization.
Support the design and delivery of sales training initiatives to build capability across the local sales team.
Track, analyse, and report on key performance indicators, feeding insights into performance reviews and transformation progress discussions.
Collaborate closely with the Market Unit Director and the regional Commercial Excellence team to ensure alignment and consistency.


Pricing & Revenue Growth Analytics


Conduct pricing and profitability analyses to directly inform commercial strategy at both local and EMEA level.
Build and maintain dashboards and market insight tools that support data-driven decision making.
Monitor the effectiveness of pricing actions and ensure findings are communicated clearly to relevant stakeholders.


What We're Looking For


2-4 years of experience in a commercial, sales, business analytics, or related role.
Solid understanding of commercial and sales processes.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM is an advantage.
Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools is a plus.
Fluency in both Danish and English.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
A proactive mindset and eagerness to work across functions in an international environment.


Why Join PPG?

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded analyst who wants to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work closely with local leadership while gaining exposure to regional commercial excellence initiatives and best practices across EMEA.

How We Work

At PPG, we bring teams together to accelerate collaboration and career development, with in-person work Monday through Thursday and the opportunity to work remotely on Flexible Fridays. Schedules may vary by location.

Ready to make an impact? Join PPG and help shape the future of commercial excellence while building a rewarding international career.

PPG: WE PROTECT AND BEAUTIFY THE WORLD®

Through leadership in innovation, sustainability and color, PPG helps customers in industrial, transportation, consumer products, and construction markets and aftermarkets to enhance more surfaces in more ways than does any other company. To learn more, visit www.ppg.com and follow @PPG on X.

The PPG Way 2030

We are customer champions

Proactive. Bold. Trustworthy. Everything we do starts with our customers. We listen, move fast and don’t stop until we solve their biggest challenges. When our customers win, we all grow.

Agile. Data-driven. Empowered. We take smart risks to stay ahead of the competition. We work proactively with agility, using quality data to develop solutions that create value.

We are excellent operators

Productive. Collaborative. Accountable. No matter our role, we identify problems, take ownership and always bring solutions. We are both proactive and responsive to drive continuous improvement and deliver results. We support our frontline, the faces of PPG to our customers.

We compete to win

Future-focused. Driven. Ambitious. We are passionate about growing our business and winning with our customers. We deliver results, embrace new technologies and leverage agility and speed as strengths.

We are PPG proud

Strong. United. Passionate. We work safely, act with integrity and value our diverse perspectives. We celebrate achievements and take pride in the positive impact we create together to protect and beautify the world.

If you need an adjustment due to a disability, please email recruiting@ppg.com.

Title: Datakonsulenter med skarpt brugerfokus
Description:
Vil du være med til at understøtte, at både Toldstyrelsens direktion og dine kolleger på grænsestregen kan træffe datadrevne beslutninger? Trives du i spændet mellem forretning og it-understøttelse, og kan du omsætte store datamængder til lettilgængelige dataprodukter, der giver indsigt? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Bidrag til effektiv databrug, og understøt effektiv toldkontrol

I Toldstyrelsens datateam understøtter vi hele styrelsen på dataområdet og arbejder for en stadig mere datadrevet styrelse. Det gør vi blandt andet ved at udvikle datarapporter, som bruges både strategisk og operationelt lige fra direktionsgangen og helt ud til grænsestregen.

Som datakonsulent vil dine opgaver omfatte at:


afdække brugernes rapporteringsbehov
udvikle opgørelser af måltal
udvikle rapporter i Power BI
undervise i brugen af datarapporter
gøre det let at være databruger i Toldstyrelsen.


Teamet løser derudover en bred vifte af opgaver, som du også får mulighed for at bidrage til. Det kan fx være test af data fra nye systemer, udvikling af styrelsens datamodenhed og datagovernance.

Datateamet er en del af kontoret Forretningsudvikling og består af en souschef og ti medarbejdere, som arbejder med data hele vejen fra udtræk ved kilden til implementering af en færdigudviklet rapport. I Forretningsudvikling får du også kolleger, der arbejder med it-udvikling, procesoptimering og porteføljestyring.

Struktureret og samarbejdsorienteret med fokus på brugeren

Din uddannelse er ikke afgørende, og du kan være nyuddannet eller have nogle års erfaring med lignende opgaver.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har arbejdet med SQL og Power BI og har erfaring med eller kendskab til at arbejde med begrebsmodeller og logiske datamodeller.

Det er vigtigt, at du har et stærkt end-to-end-fokus i udviklingen af dataprodukter. Det vil sige, at du både kan afdække og forstå behov, kan omsætte behovene til dataløsninger og kan implementere løsningerne hos brugerne. Du skal kunne dykke ned i kildedata og sammen med dine toldfaglige kolleger finde frem til de processer, hvor det giver værdi at indarbejde data.

Det er desuden vigtigt, at du har lyst til og flair for at forstå dine toldfaglige kollegers opgaver, så teamet bliver en attraktiv sparringspartner i udviklingen af en mere datadrevet Toldstyrelse.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:


arbejder struktureret
er drevet af at forstå, hvordan data kan hjælpe dine toldfaglige kolleger, og hvordan ledere kan sætte data i spil
hele tiden har den enkelte brugers dataoplevelse som pejlemærke
kan lide at samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper
går dedikeret og optimistisk til dine opgaver.


Vi understøtter en international samfundsopgave

Toldstyrelsen har ca. 800 medarbejdere fordelt over hele landet. Vi kommer med vidt forskellige baggrunde og fagligheder – men vi er alle drevet af at tage del i en vigtig opgave, og vi er stolte af de resultater, vi skaber. I staben arbejder vi hver dag ambitiøst på at understøtte styrelsens kerneopgaver, og vi samarbejder på tværs af hele organisationen om konstruktive løsninger. Hvis du har lyst til at samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i hele landet og vil være med til at løse en international opgave, der skaber værdi for Danmark og sikrer det danske samfund, så er Toldstyrelsen noget for dig. Sammen skaber vi muligheder på tværs af grænser. Som en del af din onboarding vil du deltage i både e-læring og sidemandsoplæring og evt. anden intern undervisning.

I Forretningsudvikling værdsætter vi stor selvstændighed i arbejdet, fleksibilitet og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Vi hjælper hinanden og har en uhøjtidelig og humoristisk omgangstone kombineret med en dyb respekt for vores faglighed og opgaver.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send ansøgning, CV, eksamensbevis og evt. andre relevante dokumenter via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest onsdag den 28. oktober 2026.

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte souschef Michael Philip Poulsen på telefon 72 37 72 46.

Vi forventer at holde første samtalerunde i uge 45 og anden samtalerunde mandag den 16. november, her vil der indgå en case og evt. en test.

F orud for ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest. Du skal være opmærksom på, at din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne sikkerhedsgodkendelse under din ansættelse i stillingen. Hvis du allerede er sikkerhedsgodkendt i en anden offentlig myndighed og bliver tilbudt stillingen, ønsker vi at overtage din sikkerhedsgodkendelse fra din nuværende arbejdsplads, hvis forudsætningerne for det er opfyldt.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Ansættelse vil være i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Arbejdsstedet er Lyseng Allé 1, 8270 Højbjerg. Tiltrædelse pr. 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Læs mere om ansættelse i Toldstyrelsen på toldst.dk/job

Om Toldstyrelsen

’Vi beskytter det danske samfund mod ulovlige varer og sikrer korrekt betaling af told’

Toldstyrelsens opgave er at gøre det nemt for borgere og virksomheder at betale deres told. Samtidig er det vores ansvar at beskytte det danske samfund mod indførsel af illegale varer. I de kommende år har vi desuden en vigtig opgave med at implementere EU’s toldreform, som udgør den største omstilling på toldområdet, siden EU-toldunionen blev dannet i 1968.

Vi løser fagligt krævende opgaver i komplekse processer. Derfor kræver vi stærk koordinering og høj faglighed både internt og i samarbejdet med andre aktører, nationalt såvel som internationalt.

Læs mere om Toldstyrelsen på www.toldst.dk .

Toldstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.
