Title: Senior Performance Intelligence Manager
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you an analytical and technically strong performance manager who can translate complex R&D data into decision-ready insights? Do you have experience designing performance frameworks, KPI architectures, and portfolio intelligence capabilities that help senior leaders prioritize investments, strengthen business performance, and maximize innovation value?

Join our PMO, Innovation Portfolio Management within R&D Chronic Care organisation

Coloplast has a long history of developing innovative products that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the PMO department within the R&D Innovation Portfolio Management organization, where we drive portfolio management and execution across the innovation portfolio, enable strategy deployment, and advance performance management across the R&D organization.

As Senior Performance Intelligence Manager, you will play a key role in establishing a trusted performance management system across R&D. You will create a single source of truth for portfolio, functional, and organizational performance, enabling leaders across the organization to make better business decisions, strengthen business performance, and maximize the value delivered through innovation investments. Through KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, and performance insights, you will help leaders to drive continuous performance improvement across both the Innovation Value Stream portfolio and the wider R&D organization, ensuring leaders have the insights needed to improve outcomes, productivity, and value delivery

Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

Your key responsibilities include:


Develop and maintain performance management framework and KPI matrix used to track value creation across the IVS portfolio and R&D organisation.
Design and build the Power BI data model, dashboards and reporting logic, from architecture through to visual design
Establish one trusted source of truth for portfolio, business and value performance, supporting better decisions and performance improvement across R&D and the Innovation Value Stream
Create one integrated portfolio view of milestones, cost, risk and value across programs and projects
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support value-optimising decisions for senior leadership
Work closely with Finance, R&D and IVS stakeholders to provide insights and analytical support that help leaders improve business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and make better business decisions
Develop and run value realization tracking, ensuring initiatives deliver against the impact they promised
Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation




Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

You combine business understanding with solid hands-on BI, data and analytics experience. You are comfortable working with data models, dashboards, reporting logic and performance metrics — and you can translate technical complexity into clear insights for senior stakeholders.

What you bring:


Minimum 5 years of experience in performance management, strategic PMO, portfolio management, business performance, or analytics-driven decision support
Master’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Data/Analytics, Life Science, Technology or equivalent
Strong experience designing performance management frameworks, KPI architectures, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities in a project, program, or portfolio environment.
Solid hands-on technical experience building and developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modelling, reporting logic and visual design - this is a core, hands-on part of the role
Experience supporting portfolio scenario design, trade-off discussions and fact-based decision-making
Strong stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
Experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anna Revva, Head of PMO, R&D Innovation Portfolio Management at dkanre@coloplast.com.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

  • Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
  • Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation



Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

  • Experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
  • Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English

Title: KMD - Legal Operations Analyst
Description:
RESOLVA bistår KMD med rekrutteringen af en Legal Operations Analyst




ROLLEBESKRIVELSE

KMD søger en analytisk og nysgerrig Legal Operations Analyst, der vil være med til at opbygge arbejdet med Legal Operations, Business Intelligence og Legal AI. Du kommer ind tidligt i udviklingen af en ny funktion og får mulighed for at præge, hvordan data, teknologi og procesforbedringer fremover skal understøtte den juridiske organisation, og du vil arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem data, teknologi, processer og forretning.




En central del af rollen bliver at styrke anvendelsen af data på tværs af den juridiske funktion og skabe et bedre datagrundlag for blandt andet beslutninger og ledelsesrapportering. Det indebærer blandt andet at strukturere og analysere data om f.eks. kontrakter (herunder i forbindelse med udløb eller genforhandling), juridiske complianceopgaver og andre relevante aktiviteter samt omsætte data til klare indsigter, forbedrede processer og anvendelig rapportering.




KMD har allerede implementeret nye systemer og løsninger, som danner et godt fundament for den videre udvikling af området. En del af rollen bliver i den forbindelse blandt andet at arbejde med KMD's Contract Lifecycle Management-system og bidrage til den videre udvikling af processer inden for contract management og claims management samt til, hvordan data og digitale løsninger bedst struktureres og anvendes i praksis.




Rollen rummer samtidig et væsentligt udviklings- og transformationsspor. Du vil bl.a. være med til at designe workflows og operating models, etablere fælles processer for modtagelse, prioritering og opfølgning på juridiske opgaver samt identificere muligheder for automatisering og relevant anvendelse af AI. Herudover vil du være involveret i de strategiske overvejelser om, hvor der er størst behov og potentiale for udvikling og optimering. Du vil få et tæt samarbejde med alle medarbejdere i Group Legal i forbindelse med optimering af processer på tværs af den juridiske funktion.




Du får samtidig en bred kontaktflade til tekniske specialister, ledere og den øvrige forretning. En vigtig del af rollen bliver at komme tæt på forretningen og forstå, hvordan der arbejdes i dag, identificere forbedringsmuligheder og omsætte konkrete behov til brugbare løsninger. Vi forestiller os derfor, at du er nysgerrig på, hvordan mennesker og processer fungerer i praksis, tør stille spørgsmål og kan følge løsninger hele vejen fra idé og design til implementering og anvendelse.




Rollen har større vægt på data, procesoptimering, change management og teknologi end på juridisk specialistviden. Det er derfor ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med jura og juridiske processer. Til gengæld får du mulighed for at bringe dine kompetencer i spil i en juridisk kontekst og være med til at sætte retningen for et område i markant udvikling.




TEAMET

Som Legal Operations Analyst bliver du en del af et nyt Legal Operations-team i Group Legal & Compliance. Teamet er under opbygning, og du får mulighed for at være med til at udvikle KMD's juridiske afdeling og gøre arbejdet med kontrakter og juridiske processer mere effektivt, datadrevet og teknologisk understøttet. KMD søger en kandidat, der kan supplere teamets juridiske kompetencer, og som har erfaring med og interesse for data, processer og digitale løsninger.




Legal Operations er forankret i Corporate Secretariatet og består i dag af Director Natalie Benard, som du vil rapportere til, en Compliance Officer og en student. Ambitionen er, at teamet over tid skal vokse med flere medarbejdere.




Du vil arbejde fra KMD's hovedkontor i Ballerup.




ANSVARSOMRÅDER

Som Legal Operations Analyst hos KMD vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver bl.a. bestå af følgende:




Indsamle, strukturere og analysere data om juridiske opgaver, herunder kontrakter, governance, compliance og øvrige relevante aktiviteter og sikre et solidt datagrundlag for rapportering og beslutningsstøtte.




Bidrage til at kortlægge og skabe overblik over opgaver, processer og udviklingsbehov på tværs af Group Legal samt understøtte prioriteringen af, hvor der er størst behov og potentiale for udvikling og optimering.




Udvikle rapporteringsredskaber, eksempelvis dashboards i Power BI, og på anden vis omsætte data til klare og anvendelige indsigter til brug for blandt andet ledelsesrapportering.




Designe workflows og operating models, identificere muligheder for procesforbedring og automatisering samt bidrage til at etablere fælles processer for modtagelse, prioritering og opfølgning på juridiske opgaver på tværs af Group Legal.




Identificere og afprøve relevante anvendelsesmuligheder for AI og andre digitale løsninger i den juridiske funktion.




Arbejde med KMD’s Contract Lifecycle Management-system og bidrage til den videre udvikling af processer inden for contract management og claims management.




Arbejde tæt sammen med forretningen og relevante stakeholders for at forstå eksisterende arbejdsgange, identificere behov og omsætte dem til brugbare løsninger samt understøtte implementering, change management og løbende opfølgning på løsninger og processers anvendelse og effekt.




RAPPORTERING OG TITEL

Rapportering til: Natalie Benard, Director, Legal Business Partners.




Titel: Legal Operations Analyst.




IDEELLE KOMPETENCER

Uddannelse: Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Du kan eksempelvis have en baggrund inden for Business Intelligence, Business Analytics, Data Science, Digital Business, Information Systems, Digital Innovation & Management, IT-ledelse og digitalisering, Operations Management eller Industrial Engineering.




Andre uddannelsesmæssige baggrunde med fokus på eksempelvis proces- og organisationsudvikling, automatisering eller datadrevet forretningsudvikling kan også være relevante. Det væsentlige er, at du kan kombinere data, teknologi og procesforståelse og omsætte det til konkrete forbedringer i organisationen.




En juridisk baggrund kan også være relevant, hvis den kombineres med en tydelig interesse for og forståelse af data, teknologi, procesoptimering og digital udvikling.




Erfaring & faglige kompetencer: Du har op til 3-4 års relevant erfaring og kan også være nyuddannet. Din erfaring kan eksempelvis være fra konsulentbranchen, en IT-virksomhed eller en anden virksomhed, hvor du har arbejdet med data, processer, digitalisering eller forretningsudvikling. Det er ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med juridiske processer.




Du har en stærk analytisk sans og interesse for databehandling, rapportering, procesdesign og digitalisering. Erfaring med eksempelvis Power BI, udvikling af rapporteringsværktøjer, workflow-design, procesautomatisering, AI eller change management er en fordel, men ikke et krav.




Forretningsforståelse: Du er nysgerrig på, hvordan forretningen og de enkelte arbejdsgange fungerer i praksis, og du formår at omsætte behov og udfordringer til konkrete og brugbare løsninger. Du motiveres af at identificere forbedringsmuligheder og udvikle processer og løsninger, der gør arbejdet enklere og mere effektivt.




PERSONLIGE KOMPETENCER

Analytisk & struktureret: Du arbejder analytisk og struktureret og har evnen til at skabe overblik over komplekse problemstillinger. Samtidig formår du at omsætte data til klare konklusioner og konkrete anbefalinger, der kan anvendes i praksis.




Nysgerrig & åbent mindset: Du er nysgerrig på mennesker, processer og teknologi, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at udfordre eksisterende arbejdsgange konstruktivt. Du ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger og motiveres af at designe og optimere processer.




Stakeholder management: Du trives med at være tæt på forretningen, stille spørgsmål og sætte dig ind i forskellige behov og arbejdsgange. Du samarbejder naturligt på tværs af fagligheder og kan skabe gode relationer til både jurister, ledere, tekniske specialister og øvrige stakeholders.




Hands-on tilgang: Du tager ansvar og driver opgaver fremad fra idé til implementering og anvendelse. Du har en hands-on tilgang og trives med selv at være involveret i at udvikle, teste og løbende forbedre løsninger.




ANSÆTTELSESVILKÅR

KMD tilbyder dig en spændende mulighed for at være med fra begyndelsen, når en ny Legal Operations-funktion opbygges, og brugen af data, teknologi og AI i Group Legal & Compliance udvikles. Du får reel mulighed for at præge både løsningerne, prioriteringerne og din egen rolle i takt med, at området vokser.




Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med jurister, ledere, tekniske specialister og forretningen i en kultur med frihed under ansvar og højt til loftet. KMD tilbyder attraktive ansættelsesvilkår, en hybrid arbejdsplads med stor fleksibilitet og fokus på work-life-balance.




OM KMD

KMD er en af Danmarks største IT-virksomheder og udvikler samt leverer software, IT-løsninger og digitale services til den offentlige og private sektor. Virksomheden har gennem mere end 50 år været en central del af digitaliseringen af det danske samfund og leverer løsninger, der understøtter en række samfundskritiske funktioner, herunder inden for administration af velfærdsydelser, beskæftigelsesindsatser, sundhedsrelaterede processer, uddannelsesområdet samt digital selvbetjening for borgere og virksomheder.




KMD har hovedsæde i Ballerup og beskæftiger ca. 2200 medarbejdere.




Hvis du vil vide mere om KMD, kan du besøge deres hjemmeside her: https://www.kmd.dk/.




KONTAKT OG ANSØGNING

Hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Vedlæg venligst dit CV samt anden relevant dokumentation. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Camilla Krogh på tlf. (+45 51261264) eller Mikkel Falkenberg på tlf. (+45 29993065) fra RESOLVA.

Title: BI Developer

Have an appetite for more?

Do you enjoy turning data into insights that drive better decisions? As a Business Intelligence (BI) Developer at Lantmännen Unibake, you will build Power BI solutions that help colleagues across our global business make smarter, data-driven decisions.

Lantmännen Unibake is one of the world's leading bakery groups, operating in more than 20 countries and partnering with global brands such as McDonald's, Starbucks and Aldi. Based at our international HQ in Copenhagen, you will join a collaborative Data, Analytics and Integrations team and play a key role in shaping how data is used across our business.

This Is What You Will Do

As a BI Developer (internally referred to as BI Specialist), you will act as the link between business stakeholders and our data team, translating their goals and requirements into scalable analytics solutions, typically built on Power BI. From development new reports from scratch through to enhancing our existing products, you will build models and reports that create real business value for our units, supporting over 800 users on a weekly basis.

Your Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across HQ and our business units to understand their requirements and deliver impactful BI solutions.
Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and visualizations that support data-driven decision-making.
Build and optimize data models using DAX, Power Query and BI best practices.
Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure reliable and scalable reporting solutions built on our Unibake Data Platform, using the latest Snowflake technologies
Drive user adoption through training, demonstrations, testing and stakeholder engagement.
Continuously improve existing reports and dashboards to enhance performance and business value.
Provide ongoing support for our global BI community and promote analytics best practices across the organization.


,

What You Bring


3+ years of experience working with Power BI, including developing dashboards, reports and data models using DAX, with good knowledge of best practices for scalable enterprise solutions
Strong knowledge of SQL, Power Query and Row-Level Security (RLS)
Experience with Snowflake, Azure DevOps, or Tabular Editor is considered an advantage.
Previous exposure to the manufacturing industry is highly valued.
A talent for translating business requirements into intuitive and impactful analytics solutions.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with the confidence to present solutions to business users.
A proactive and analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities.


What We Offer


Competitive salary package.
10% pension contribution and health insurance.
Internet allowance, company phone and free parking.
A collaborative office-first HQ environment where you can learn, innovate and build relationships with colleagues from 31+ nationalities.
International career opportunities within a growing global organization.
Company events and activities


Location / Travel

The role is based at Lantmännen Unibake International HQ in Copenhagen, Ørestad, one minute from the Metro.

Expect around 10-15 travel days per year, mainly during key project phases.

Sounds interesting?

Ready to help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at Lantmännen Unibake?

We would love to hear from you. Please apply with your English CV as soon as possible, as we interview candidates on an ongoing basis.

Do you enjoy turning data into insights that drive better decisions? As a Business Intelligence (BI) Developer at Lantmännen Unibake, you will build Power BI solutions that help colleagues across our global business make smarter, data-driven decisions.

Lantmännen Unibake is one of the world's leading bakery groups, operating in more than 20 countries and partnering with global brands such as McDonald's, Starbucks and Aldi. Based at our international HQ in Copenhagen, you will join a collaborative Data, Analytics and Integrations team and play a key role in shaping how data is used across our business.

This Is What You Will Do

As a BI Developer (internally referred to as BI Specialist), you will act as the link between business stakeholders and our data team, translating their goals and requirements into scalable analytics solutions, typically built on Power BI. From development new reports from scratch through to enhancing our existing products, you will build models and reports that create real business value for our units, supporting over 800 users on a weekly basis.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with stakeholders across HQ and our business units to understand their requirements and deliver impactful BI solutions.
  • Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and visualizations that support data-driven decision-making.
  • Build and optimize data models using DAX, Power Query and BI best practices.
  • Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure reliable and scalable reporting solutions built on our Unibake Data Platform, using the latest Snowflake technologies
  • Drive user adoption through training, demonstrations, testing and stakeholder engagement.
  • Continuously improve existing reports and dashboards to enhance performance and business value.
  • Provide ongoing support for our global BI community and promote analytics best practices across the organization.

,

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience working with Power BI, including developing dashboards, reports and data models using DAX, with good knowledge of best practices for scalable enterprise solutions
  • Strong knowledge of SQL, Power Query and Row-Level Security (RLS)
  • Experience with Snowflake, Azure DevOps, or Tabular Editor is considered an advantage.
  • Previous exposure to the manufacturing industry is highly valued.
  • A talent for translating business requirements into intuitive and impactful analytics solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with the confidence to present solutions to business users.
  • A proactive and analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary package.
  • 10% pension contribution and health insurance.
  • Internet allowance, company phone and free parking.
  • A collaborative office-first HQ environment where you can learn, innovate and build relationships with colleagues from 31+ nationalities.
  • International career opportunities within a growing global organization.
  • Company events and activities

Location / Travel

The role is based at Lantmännen Unibake International HQ in Copenhagen, Ørestad, one minute from the Metro.

Expect around 10-15 travel days per year, mainly during key project phases.

Sounds interesting?

Ready to help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at Lantmännen Unibake?

We would love to hear from you. Please apply with your English CV as soon as possible, as we interview candidates on an ongoing basis.

Title: Senior Business-oriented Data Analytics Engineer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you passionate about translating data into actionable insights? Do you have experience within Data & Analytics?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior Business-oriented Data Analytics Engineer.




Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.




We are seeking a passionate Senior Business-oriented Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in being the trusted partner to business stakeholders to enable data-driven decision-making across Drug Development Domain. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborating with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the Drug Development Data Domain (4D) team consisting of 3 colleagues, and report directly to People Leader in Global IT, Babak Bajelan and Global Head of Digitalization, Ivanna Rosendal who are based in Hellerup, Denmark. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.




Your key responsibilities will be:

Understand business needs and translate them into data solutions
Design & develop data products that drive business value and decisions
Explore and transform complex data into insights with fit-for-purpose analytics
Collaborate across teams to build end-to-end solutions
Ensure data products align with data governance, compliance, and quality standards




Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a Master's Degree in Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Science or related field - and 5+years of experience within Data & Analytics.




Furthermore, you have:

Proven experience in gathering and transforming business requirements into data products
3+ years of hands-on experience with DevOps, Databricks, dbt, Python and T-SQL
Experience in designing & delivering solutions using Power BI or similar BI platforms
Understanding of data governance, data quality, and compliance
Ability to understand business data & processes and create rapid prototypes




Pharma domain knowledge is a plus.




Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.




To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be

proactive, collaborative and results oriented
driving initiatives from idea to adoption
curious and open minded




Travel: 10-20 days per year.




Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup




Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

To ensure your application is reviewed, please submit it through the specified platform - applications sent by email or other channels will not be evaluated.

For more details about the position or the company, please contact Global Head of Digitalization, Ivanna Rosendal, imr@ascendispharma.com or People Leader in Global IT, Babak Bajelan, bab@ascendispharma.com




You can learn more about Ascendis Pharma by visiting our website www.ascendispharma.com

Applications must be submitted in English and will be treated confidentially.




A note to recruiters:

We do not allow external search party solicitation. Presentation of candidates without written permission from the Ascendis Pharma HR team (specifically from: Talent Acquisition Partner or Human Resources Director) is not allowed. If this occurs, your ownership of these candidates will not be acknowledged.

Title: DD&IT Associate Performance Manager - turn data into strategic insights
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to help leaders make better decisions by turning performance data into clear, actionable insights? And are you ready to take ownership of defined analyses, reporting products and improvement initiatives?

Then this is your chance to develop your expertise in Digital, Data and IT (DD&IT) performance management and analytics, with room to grow into an influential performance and insights role – all while working at a company dedicated to making life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs.

Join the department that connects performance and strategy

You will join our Strategy, Performance and Portfolio department within DD&IT, based in Humlebæk.

Here, you will work at the intersection of strategy execution, performance management and operational improvement. Working closely with leaders, finance -and data specialists, you will help improve how we measure, understand and communicate performance across DD&IT.

Connect the dots between strategy and results

Your work will range from translating leadership questions into meaningful KPIs to developing sustainable reporting solutions. By connecting operational, financial, portfolio and strategy execution perspectives, you will help create transparency, identify opportunities for improvement and provide decision-ready insights that support our strategic priorities.

Over time, you will also contribute to establishing a consistent and trusted performance management approach that helps DD&IT focus resources and investments where they create the most value.

More specifically, you will:


turn strategic priorities into analytical requirements and actionable performance measures aligned across stakeholders
conduct analyses and deep dives to uncover trends, risks, root causes and improvement opportunities, translating findings into clear recommendations for leadership
design, maintain and continuously improve dashboards and reporting products that make complex performance data accessible and easy to interpret
define reporting requirements and work with data owners and specialists to ensure reliable, consistent and sustainable reporting
prepare insights for performance reviews and leadership discussions, facilitate conversations about metrics and improvement opportunities, and use data storytelling to communicate complex findings clearly




You combine analytical thinking with business curiosity

We do not expect you to be an expert in every technical discipline as long as you are curious and proactive. What matters is that you can translate ambiguous reporting needs into clear project scopes and delivering performance reporting that enable data-driven decision making.

In addition, we imagine that you:


hold a master's degree in business, economics, finance, strategy, engineering, data or a related field
have relevant analytical experience from a graduate role, internship, consultancy project or similar environment, ideally involving digital, data & IT performance data
have experience identifying patterns in data, drawing conclusions and communicating clear recommendations
have experience with Power BI, Power Query/M and DAX, along with an understanding of data modelling concepts and reporting structures such as star schemas and semantic models
understand data quality, governance, reporting standards and performance measurement principles.




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the role please reach out to Head of Strategy Performance & PMO.

We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.

 

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Title: Data Specialist - 12 Month FTC
Place: Billund, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Job Description

As our Data Specialist, you'll help collect, validate, manage and analyse commercial data, transforming information into actionable insights that support business growth. You'll work across data ingestion, data quality and reporting activities, partnering with stakeholders to ensure the right data is available to the right people at the right time. This is a replacement role on a fixed-term maternity cover contract.

Required Qualifications



Managed data ingestion processes and maintained reliable data flows.
Performed data quality reviews, validation activities and issue resolution on customer or sales datasets.
Generated commercial data quality insights that supported business decision-making and growth.
Translated sales or commercial data into clear recommendations for business stakeholders.
Worked closely with commercial teams and cross-functional partners to deliver data-driven outcomes.


Preferred Qualifications



You have strong collaboration skills and want to join an international working environment.
You are curious about the business, have an affinity for data, and are energized to review the status quo and actively support improvements.
You have analytical skills with proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite herein Excel and experience with SQL and/or Python for data analysis and reporting
Partnered with stakeholders across multiple business units or regions.


What You'll Build



Reliable data ingestion and validation processes.
High-quality commercial datasets that support reporting and analysis.
Clear insights that help teams understand performance and identify opportunities.
Strong partnerships between data teams, commercial teams and business stakeholders.
Scalable reporting approaches that improve decision-making and confidence in data.


If you've worked in a role where you managed commercial data, maintained data quality and produced meaningful business insights, you'll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to turn data into action, communicate clearly with stakeholders and deliver dependable results through strong analytical thinking.

Life on the team

You'll join a team that works closely together, sharing knowledge and supporting one another to solve data challenges. We're looking for someone who enjoys exploring data, is curious about how the business works and takes satisfaction in finding patterns, trends and opportunities. You'll thrive if you enjoy learning, asking questions and helping others build confidence in data.

What Success Looks Like

Success means becoming a trusted partner for commercial stakeholders, ensuring data quality remains high and providing insights that help shape decisions. Over time, you'll contribute to the team's evolving priorities and future initiatives while working closely with commercial teams and cross-functional colleagues. You'll be recognised for reliable delivery, constructive collaboration and the quality of the insights you provide.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

What’s in it for you?

Here is what you can expect

Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times.

Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind.

Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity.

Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount.

Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme.

Your workplace Your workplace will be the office, store or factory specified in this advert.

Hybrid Working Our hybrid work model, Best of Both offers you the option of flexibility to work from home up to two days per week. Your People Leader will discuss the principles of the model, including how this option applies to your role and team.

Learn more about our benefits, culture and workplace experience here

Title: Commercial Excellence Analyst I, Senior
Place: Gladsaxe, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Commercial Excellence Analyst

PPG is a global coatings company with operations in over 70 countries and more than 180 years of industry leadership. As part of its Architectural Coatings EMEA division, PPG is executing a significant commercial transformation across all markets, and the Danish market is a key part of that journey.

This role is central to making that transformation happen on the ground while contributing to a regional agenda that reaches well beyond Denmark. For the right candidate, it offers a rare combination of local impact, regional visibility, and the opportunity to develop cross-functional expertise across commercial strategy, data analytics, and change leadership from day one.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Excellence & Sales Transformation


Coordinate and drive the implementation of PPG's sales transformation framework across the Danish market, covering seven key streams: sales talent, sales training, sales leadership, Salesforce CRM pipeline management, operating cadence, customer relationship management, and sales enablement.
Act as the bridge between global strategy and local execution, ensuring that regional priorities are adapted and embedded effectively within the local organization.
Support the design and delivery of sales training initiatives to build capability across the local sales team.
Track, analyse, and report on key performance indicators, feeding insights into performance reviews and transformation progress discussions.
Collaborate closely with the Market Unit Director and the regional Commercial Excellence team to ensure alignment and consistency.


Pricing & Revenue Growth Analytics


Conduct pricing and profitability analyses to directly inform commercial strategy at both local and EMEA level.
Build and maintain dashboards and market insight tools that support data-driven decision making.
Monitor the effectiveness of pricing actions and ensure findings are communicated clearly to relevant stakeholders.


What We're Looking For


2-4 years of experience in a commercial, sales, business analytics, or related role.
Solid understanding of commercial and sales processes.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM is an advantage.
Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence tools is a plus.
Fluency in both Danish and English.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.
A proactive mindset and eagerness to work across functions in an international environment.


Why Join PPG?

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded analyst who wants to combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You will work closely with local leadership while gaining exposure to regional commercial excellence initiatives and best practices across EMEA.

How We Work

At PPG, we bring teams together to accelerate collaboration and career development, with in-person work Monday through Thursday and the opportunity to work remotely on Flexible Fridays. Schedules may vary by location.

Ready to make an impact? Join PPG and help shape the future of commercial excellence while building a rewarding international career.

Title: Senior Analyst - Consumer Credit Risk & Underwriting
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Klarna, briefly

At Klarna, we're building an everyday finance network, helping over 120 million consumers across 26 countries save time and money, and worry less about their finances.Working at Klarna means taking on problems most companies never get to solve, and being hands-on enough that the interesting part of the work lands with you, not someone else. You'll build with AI, not watch it happen.

This is the stretch zone. Come find out what you're capable of.

About The Role

Klarna is bringing its Fair Financing product live in Denmark. As a Senior Analyst on the credit decisioning team, you'll build and defend the underwriting policies that decide who gets credit in Denmark and on what terms, working from bureau data and models built specifically for the Danish market.

You'll work alongside Product, Risk, and the regional Belgium team to bring that policy onto Klarna's Global Underwriting Platform (GUP), the shared framework that will power credit decisions across markets.

What You'll Do


You'll analyze consumer credit risk using SQL and Danish credit bureau data to find where underwriting policy should tighten or loosen.
You'll work with Product, Risk, and the Danish regional team to bring Denmark’s credit policy onto Klarna's Global Underwriting Platform.
You'll align purchase power and pre-qualification logic for the Danish market across Klarna's App and its One Card product.
You'll monitor how the Danish bureau data feeding your models performs, and flag where sourcing or model quality needs to change.
You'll turn what your analysis shows into policy changes that underwriting, product, and the regional team can act on directly.


Who you are


You've worked in consumer credit risk, underwriting, or credit policy, and you understand how a policy change affects both approval rates and portfolio health.
You're proficient in SQL and comfortable working directly with large, messy datasets.
You know credit bureau data, repayment behavior, and credit risk modeling well enough to spot where the numbers don't add up.
You work through ambiguous or inconsistent policy logic methodically until you find the actual root cause.
You can turn a data finding into a policy change that underwriting, product, and regional teams can each act on.


Bonus points for


A degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.


Things you should know before applying


Working together: we value co-located teams; most teams currently meet in the office 2–3 days per week, and this varies by team and can change over time.
Non-obvious backgrounds are welcome. Diversity of skills, perspectives and backgrounds is how we create, innovate, and disrupt like no other.
Final compensation will be based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and experience.
Depending on your background, this could land as an Analyst role or a Data Scientist role — we'll settle the exact title with you once we understand your experience.


Please include a CV in English.

Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it’s like to work here? Explore our career site.

Title: Business Intelligence Specialist
Description:
Humantrust søger for anonym virksomhed.




Vil du være den interne specialist, der omsætter data og forretningsbehov til løsninger og dashboards, der kan bruges i praksis? I denne rolle får du lov at opbygge Power BI-rapporterne fra bunden.




Gør Power BI til et stærkt værktøj for hele forretningen

Vores kunde er godt i gang med et større Power BI-projekt, hvor datagrundlaget og den tekniske platform er ved at være på plads med hjælp fra eksterne konsulenter. Nu skal løsningen for alvor ud at leve i organisationen. Som Business Intelligence Specialist bliver du derfor det interne anker, der bygger Power BI-rapportering og dashboards op med afsæt i forretningens behov.




Du bliver en del af Finance-teamet i virksomheden, som holder til i Trekantområdet. Dit første fokus bliver at få opbygget finansrapporteringen, men du får hurtigt en bred kontaktflade på tværs af virksomheden.




Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

udvikle og vedligeholde rapporter og dashboards i Power BI
omsætte forretningens behov til konkrete datadrevne løsninger og sparre med ledere og nøglepersoner på tværs af organisationen
udarbejde og optimere datamodeller og DAX-beregninger
arbejde med strukturering og modellering af data fra forskellige kilder
identificere og implementere muligheder for at automatisere og optimere rapporteringsprocesser
i samarbejde med eksterne konsulenter bidrage til den videre udvikling af Microsoft Fabric-platformen




Du kombinerer stærke Power BI-kompetencer med forståelse for forretningen

Du kommer med en solid BI-værktøjskasse frontendmæssigt og er samtidig nysgerrig på den forretning, dine løsninger skal understøtte. Den værktøjskasse består af flere års erfaring med Power BI og stærke kompetencer inden for DAX og datamodellering, ligesom du har arbejdet med SQL og større datamængder. Data Warehouse ligger i Microsoft Fabric, men det er ikke et krav, at du har arbejdet med det før.




Din baggrund kan være en klassisk BI-profil, men du kan også komme fra revision eller en rolle som Business Controller og siden have bevæget dig længere ind i data og BI. Hvis du har forståelse for regnskab, økonomistyring og finansielle processer er det en fordel – det samme gælder erfaring med ledelsesrapportering.




Dit analytiske blik går hånd i hånd med lysten til at forstå behovet bag tallene. Du trives derfor med at komme ud i organisationen, stille spørgsmål og gå i dialog med både tekniske og forretningsorienterede interessenter. Samtidig arbejder du selvstændigt og har modet til at udfordre og optimere eksisterende måder at gøre tingene på – og de gode relationelle evner, der skal til for at få organisationen med på nye løsninger.




Hvis du motiveres af at kombinere din BI-faglighed med tæt kontakt til forretningen og gerne vil sætte dit præg på en BI-funktion under udvikling, så send os dit CV og motivation under ’Søg jobbet’.

Title: Konsulent til Dataenheden på Herlev og Gentofte Hospital
Place: Gentofte, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Herlev og Gentofte Hospital søger en konsulent til Dataenheden, der vil være med til at styrke vores arbejde med ledelsesinformation samt aktivitets- og kapacitetsanalyser.





Dataenheden er en del af Økonomiafdelingen og består af otte dygtige og erfarne kollegaer. Vi leverer analyser og indsigter til hospitalets kliniske afdelinger og direktion og bidrager til at skabe overblik over aktivitet, kapacitet og udvikling på tværs af et af Danmarks største hospitaler.





Udover Dataenheden består Økonomiafdelingen af en Budgetenhed og en Planlægningsenhed med i alt 44 ansatte.





Stillingens indhold





Som konsulent i Dataenheden bidrager du til, at hospitalets ledelse og kliniske afdelinger træffer beslutninger på et solidt datagrundlag om aktivitet, kapacitet og ressourceanvendelse. Du arbejder med analyser af aktivitet, patientforløb og kapacitetsudnyttelse og omsætter data til beslutningsstøtte og konkrete indsigter. Opgaverne spænder fra idéudvikling og databehandling til formidling og implementering, og omfatter også udvikling af datamodeller i Region Hovedstadens data- og analyseplatform. Du får en bred samarbejdsflade med kliniske afdelinger, hospitalets direktion, øvrige administrative stabe og andre samarbejdspartnere i forbindelse med analyser, projekter og planlægningsopgaver.





Arbejdsopgaverne vil være indenfor følgende områder: 






Betjening af 3-4 kliniske afdelinger vedrørende aktivitets- og ressourcespørgsmål


Modeludvikling og databearbejdning i Data- og analyseplatformen


Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af hospitalets ledelsesinformation


Aktivitets- og ressourcestyring


Kapacitetsanalyser og analyser ved ændringer i hospitalsaktiviteten


Samarbejde på tværs af stabene



 





Du kommer til at arbejde i et moderne datamiljø baseret på Databricks, Tabular Editor og Power BI understøttet af AI til vores modeludvikling og databehandling.





Du refererer til enhedschefen i Dataenheden og vil i din dagligdag samarbejde bredt i hele organisationen.





Vores forventninger til dig  





Du trives med at analysere store datamængder og omsætte resultaterne til klar ledelsesinformation og konkrete anbefalinger. Dataenheden fungerer som en servicefunktion for hele hospitalet. Du skal derfor være serviceminded og kunne indgå i dialog med andre faggrupper på forskellige niveauer i organisationen.





Du har erfaring med analyse og databehandling, og du har en videregående uddannelse. Kendskab til sundhedsvæsenet er ikke et krav, men en fordel. Vi forventer, at du:






Besidder en veludviklet analytisk sans og kan håndtere komplekse data



 






Har erfaring med analyseværktøjer som fx Power BI, SQL, SAS eller lignende


Kan medvirke til fagligt at udvikle enhedens opgaveløsninger


Kan bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø



 





Vi tilbyder





Du får spændende opgaver inden for sundhedsvæsenet og stor berøring med den kliniske hverdag på et af Danmarks største akut- og kræfthospitaler. Du får i høj grad indflydelse på dine opgaver. Omgangstonen i afdelingen er uformel og imødekommende, og der vil være rig mulighed for at sparre med erfarne kolleger. Vi er også en familievenlig arbejdsplads med høj grad af fleksibilitet.





Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt, og du ansættes enten i henhold til overenskomst for akademikere ansat i regioner m.v. eller i henhold til overenskomst for administrations og IT-personale m.fl. Dit primære arbejdssted bliver på Gentofte Hospital. En del mødeaktivitet på Herlev Hospital må dog forventes.





Hvis du vil høre mere





Du er velkommen til at søge yderligere oplysninger hos konst. enhedschef Diane Jensen på tlf. 38 67 21 77 eller konsulent Camilla Dahl Ipsen på tlf. 38 67 21 96.





Du skal sende din ansøgning senest søndag den 1. november 2026 med henblik på ansættelse 1. januar 2027.

Title: Procurement Analyst
Place: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you a curious & analytical thinker with a passion for both numbers and people? Would you like to be part of shaping and executing our Procurement Analytics transformation?

Join Ambu’s Global Procurement Transformation Journey

At our headquarters in Ballerup, you will become a part of our Procurement Insights team, a cross-functional unit within the Global Procurement department. Your day will involve collaborating with strategic procurement colleagues spanned out across the globe, from Malaysia to Mexico, China and the US as well as numerous stakeholders from different corners of the company.

In Procurement Insights, we enable and support our colleagues to deliver excellent procurement value. With data, analytics, and business intelligence we are evolving the way we do procurement.

Data & Analytics meets Procurement

We are currently investing in our people, processes and technology to enable value-driven procurement decisions. You will join a team of skilled & dedicated colleagues working to develop the data & analytics capability of the future for Global Procurement.

Your role will be key to ensuring that we take full advantage of the data & technology at our disposal, by bringing your curiosity, analytical skills and critical thinking into play.

You will be an important player in bringing this ambition to life

Skills

In this role you will be expected to use your skills to create real impact in a fast-growing, global organization. As our new Procurement Analyst, some of your main tasks will be:


Executing various analytics projects, e.g., market-, commodity- & fundamental analysis, forecasting, cost-breakdown modelling & should-cost analysis, etc.
Providing procurement colleagues with various data, insights, and tool & application support for projects and activities at various stages (tendering, contract negotiations, etc.)
Developing new analytical concepts, modelling, and -systems to provide actionable insights into market and spend developments for our key stakeholders
Shaping and developing the future analytics agenda of Global Procurement to ensure we get the most out of our data and technology, as well as making sure that we stay on top of future analytics trends


Curious & Analytical thinker with a passion for numbers, people & technology

It is vital that you are curious about how things work and have a strong interest in data & analytics. We expect you to naturally seek new challenges, tasks, and technology. You possess strong communication and people skills, enabling you to build sound relationships and collaborate well across multiple functions.

We imagine our new Procurement Analyst having some years of relevant work experience. You likely have an M.Sc. in Business Intelligence, Data Science, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or similar.


Have strong analytical skills and take a critical approach to the data and problems you work with
Find pragmatic solutions by applying methods and theory balanced with a good understanding of business needs
Experiment and aren’t afraid of failing while trying new things
Use your analytical mindset and a structured way of working, to competently translate high complexity into simple concepts, and communicate these clearly and concisely
Are fluent in English


Application deadline: 18th October 2026

Data & Analytics meets Procurement

Title: Datakonsulenter med skarpt brugerfokus
Description:
Vil du være med til at understøtte, at både Toldstyrelsens direktion og dine kolleger på grænsestregen kan træffe datadrevne beslutninger? Trives du i spændet mellem forretning og it-understøttelse, og kan du omsætte store datamængder til lettilgængelige dataprodukter, der giver indsigt? Så er du måske vores nye kollega.

Bidrag til effektiv databrug, og understøt effektiv toldkontrol

I Toldstyrelsens datateam understøtter vi hele styrelsen på dataområdet og arbejder for en stadig mere datadrevet styrelse. Det gør vi blandt andet ved at udvikle datarapporter, som bruges både strategisk og operationelt lige fra direktionsgangen og helt ud til grænsestregen.

Som datakonsulent vil dine opgaver omfatte at:


afdække brugernes rapporteringsbehov
udvikle opgørelser af måltal
udvikle rapporter i Power BI
undervise i brugen af datarapporter
gøre det let at være databruger i Toldstyrelsen.


Teamet løser derudover en bred vifte af opgaver, som du også får mulighed for at bidrage til. Det kan fx være test af data fra nye systemer, udvikling af styrelsens datamodenhed og datagovernance.

Datateamet er en del af kontoret Forretningsudvikling og består af en souschef og ti medarbejdere, som arbejder med data hele vejen fra udtræk ved kilden til implementering af en færdigudviklet rapport. I Forretningsudvikling får du også kolleger, der arbejder med it-udvikling, procesoptimering og porteføljestyring.

Struktureret og samarbejdsorienteret med fokus på brugeren

Din uddannelse er ikke afgørende, og du kan være nyuddannet eller have nogle års erfaring med lignende opgaver.

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har arbejdet med SQL og Power BI og har erfaring med eller kendskab til at arbejde med begrebsmodeller og logiske datamodeller.

Det er vigtigt, at du har et stærkt end-to-end-fokus i udviklingen af dataprodukter. Det vil sige, at du både kan afdække og forstå behov, kan omsætte behovene til dataløsninger og kan implementere løsningerne hos brugerne. Du skal kunne dykke ned i kildedata og sammen med dine toldfaglige kolleger finde frem til de processer, hvor det giver værdi at indarbejde data.

Det er desuden vigtigt, at du har lyst til og flair for at forstå dine toldfaglige kollegers opgaver, så teamet bliver en attraktiv sparringspartner i udviklingen af en mere datadrevet Toldstyrelse.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:


arbejder struktureret
er drevet af at forstå, hvordan data kan hjælpe dine toldfaglige kolleger, og hvordan ledere kan sætte data i spil
hele tiden har den enkelte brugers dataoplevelse som pejlemærke
kan lide at samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper
går dedikeret og optimistisk til dine opgaver.


Vi understøtter en international samfundsopgave

Toldstyrelsen har ca. 800 medarbejdere fordelt over hele landet. Vi kommer med vidt forskellige baggrunde og fagligheder – men vi er alle drevet af at tage del i en vigtig opgave, og vi er stolte af de resultater, vi skaber. I staben arbejder vi hver dag ambitiøst på at understøtte styrelsens kerneopgaver, og vi samarbejder på tværs af hele organisationen om konstruktive løsninger. Hvis du har lyst til at samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i hele landet og vil være med til at løse en international opgave, der skaber værdi for Danmark og sikrer det danske samfund, så er Toldstyrelsen noget for dig. Sammen skaber vi muligheder på tværs af grænser. Som en del af din onboarding vil du deltage i både e-læring og sidemandsoplæring og evt. anden intern undervisning.

I Forretningsudvikling værdsætter vi stor selvstændighed i arbejdet, fleksibilitet og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Vi hjælper hinanden og har en uhøjtidelig og humoristisk omgangstone kombineret med en dyb respekt for vores faglighed og opgaver.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår

Send ansøgning, CV, eksamensbevis og evt. andre relevante dokumenter via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest onsdag den 28. oktober 2026.

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, kan du kontakte souschef Michael Philip Poulsen på telefon 72 37 72 46.

Vi forventer at holde første samtalerunde i uge 45 og anden samtalerunde mandag den 16. november, her vil der indgå en case og evt. en test.

F orud for ansættelsen indhenter vi referencer og straffeattest. Du skal være opmærksom på, at din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne sikkerhedsgodkendelse under din ansættelse i stillingen. Hvis du allerede er sikkerhedsgodkendt i en anden offentlig myndighed og bliver tilbudt stillingen, ønsker vi at overtage din sikkerhedsgodkendelse fra din nuværende arbejdsplads, hvis forudsætningerne for det er opfyldt.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet.

Ansættelse vil være i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Arbejdsstedet er Lyseng Allé 1, 8270 Højbjerg. Tiltrædelse pr. 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale.

Læs mere om ansættelse i Toldstyrelsen på toldst.dk/job

Om Toldstyrelsen

’Vi beskytter det danske samfund mod ulovlige varer og sikrer korrekt betaling af told’

Toldstyrelsens opgave er at gøre det nemt for borgere og virksomheder at betale deres told. Samtidig er det vores ansvar at beskytte det danske samfund mod indførsel af illegale varer. I de kommende år har vi desuden en vigtig opgave med at implementere EU’s toldreform, som udgør den største omstilling på toldområdet, siden EU-toldunionen blev dannet i 1968.

Vi løser fagligt krævende opgaver i komplekse processer. Derfor kræver vi stærk koordinering og høj faglighed både internt og i samarbejdet med andre aktører, nationalt såvel som internationalt.

Læs mere om Toldstyrelsen på www.toldst.dk .

Toldstyrelsen opfordrer alle kvalificerede uanset alder, køn, seksuel orientering, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

Title: People Analytics and Data Strategy Engineer (parental leave cover), People & Culture, Copenhagen
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you excited by the intersection of people, data, and AI? Join us in shaping the future of People Analytics through modern analytics engineering, meaningful workforce insights, and data-driven decision-making.

About The Role

Covering for the People Analytics and Data Strategy Engineer (“Data Analyst”), you will play a key role in taking the People & Culture data experience to the next level and support Urban Partners in reaching our ambitious goal of building the urban future, together. If you get energy from working for an internationally growing company and want to be part of making a difference, you may be our new team member!

In our People & Culture Team, we are a group of 16 colleagues covering 8 countries working together to support the business stakeholders in embodying our purpose and vision of making a difference for cities and people. You will have extensive interaction with team members and colleagues across the organization, promising exposure to a diverse range of expertise.

We can guarantee a dynamic environment with skilled colleagues, offering opportunities for learning, collaboration, and personal growth. You will be a part of a powerhouse of brilliant and caring people raising the bar for the industry. Your workplace will be at our headquarters located in Copenhagen, Nordhavn. As an international team, we regularly engage with colleagues across borders, fostering a global perspective and collaborative spirit.

In this role, you will be reporting to our Head of Reward, located in Copenhagen. The majority of this role will be carried out from our office with some flexibility.

This is a parental leave cover role on a fixed-term contract until end July 2027. Please note: we are unable to sponsor visa or work permit applications for this position. Applicants are responsible for ensuring they have the necessary right to work in Denmark prior to applying.

Key Responsibilities

Over the past year, we've been experimenting with what People Analytics looks like when you treat it more like modern analytics engineering than traditional HR reporting. We have built our own analytics layer in Microsoft Fabric around an SCD2 master dataset of our employee population, with a Python semantic library on top. The setup supports workforce reporting used across senior management, the Board, financial planning, sustainability reporting and investor materials.

The role spans three closely connected areas: recurring workforce reporting, traditional People Analytics, and Reward. That means you'll work with everything from headcount and attrition analysis to the compensation review, pay transparency and ad hoc workforce questions. We've also designed the environment to work closely with modern AI assistants. LLMs are used to understand existing code, explore data, debug problems and help extend the analytical layer. We think this combination of structured data, reusable analytical logic and AI-assisted development represents an interesting direction for how People Analytics can work.

As Data Analyst, it is not simply a role where you “just” run existing reports and scripts. You'll inherit a working analytical system, learn how it fits together, keep it running reliably, and extend it when new business questions arise.

At the center of the setup is a master employee-history dataset combining the SCD2 states of our core HiBob data into one resolved timeline.

It allows us to reconstruct the workforce at historical points in time, covering approximately 20 years of employee history, with many core business rules already built into the data.

On top of this sits a Python semantic library with reusable building blocks for employee populations, joiners and leavers, turnover breakdowns, workforce bridges and much more.

Python notebooks use these components to produce recurring and ad hoc outputs including HTML reports, PowerPoint materials and Excel files.

The important part is not simply knowing how to run these tools. It is understanding the logic behind them, spotting when something does not look right, and knowing how far an answer needs to be taken before it creates business value.

These Will Be Some Of Your Key Tasks


Deliver key parts of the Reward cycle, including the 2027 salary review and gender pay gap and pay transparency reporting
Support the data agenda for People & Culture, with the help of your People Lead
Monitor data quality and investigate inconsistencies before they reach reporting.
Run recurring workforce reporting covering headcount, FTE movement, joiners, leavers and attrition
Support FP&A, Sustainability and Capital Formation with workforce data and analysis.
Work on broader People Analytics questions, including workforce trends, organizational development and ad hoc analysis for senior stakeholders
Answer new workforce questions as they arise
Make careful extensions to the Python semantic library and reporting notebooks when needed
Work with the BI team when source data or pipeline changes affect reporting
Keep P&C's handling of employee data GDPR-compliant
Build awareness and capabilities for the People & Culture team on data, analysis, and tools (e.g. Fabric, PowerBI, Excel)


Your Experience & Skills


You're strong in Python and genuinely enjoy using it to solve problems
You use LLMs such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot extensively to understand code, explore unfamiliar systems, debug problems and work faster
You know that AI output still needs to be tested and verified
You're comfortable learning things you haven't seen before
You have a strong instinct for when data looks wrong
You're comfortable taking ownership and working with senior stakeholders
Ideally you have experience within remuneration or broader HR
Ability to present data insights through clear and engaging visualizations
Comfortable working with systems, ideally HR-related platforms


Your character

We hope you are a curious and continuous learner with a positive mindset. You take initiative, enjoy tackling challenges, and look for opportunities to improve the way things are done. Attention to detail is second nature, and you bring a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach to complex problems. You're excited by how AI is transforming analytical work, while remaining focused on delivering accurate, useful, and high-quality outcomes.

Strong communication skills, diplomacy, and empathy are essential for building positive relationships across teams and functions. With a collaborative and service-minded approach, along with professional-level English skills, you thrive in a dynamic and international environment.

What We Offer

Make a difference by helping create urban spaces and places that enrich people’s lives in the most sustainable way

Lead the industry with an innovator that is pioneering new approaches while raising standards and inspiring the industry

Learn and grow as part of a powerhouse of brilliant people where teamwork, feedback and different ways of thinking are at the core

Be your whole self in a purpose-driven culture with a strong sense of belonging, based on trust, celebration and caring for each other

Join us

If this opportunity interests you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications are reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis. Application deadline: 3 November.

We are happy to answer questions for more information, so please reach out to Joe Dias at jodi@urban.partners.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Title: Business Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Would you like to combine business analysis, capacity planning and data-driven decision support in a growing international organisation? At Unilabs Pharma Solutions, you will work closely with management and play a key role in creating the transparency and insights needed to support growth, prioritisation and operational excellence.




Unilabs Pharma Solutions is looking for a Business Analyst to strengthen planning, resource management and decision support across the organisation. The company is one of Europe’s leading providers of diagnostic services and the position as Business Analyst is based at Unilabs Pharma Solutions in Copenhagen, a specialty laboratory that supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies worldwide with bioanalysis, immunoassays and molecular biology – primarily in the later stages of drug development and clinical studies.




By transforming complex operational and project data into actionable insights, forecasts and planning tools, you will enable informed decision-making across the organisation. Your analyses will help leadership optimise capacity, prioritise resources and support sustainable business growth, while contributing to both short-term operational performance and long-term strategic planning.




To support its continued growth, the company has created this newly established position at a pivotal stage of its development. As the organisation continues to grow and evolve, you will have a unique opportunity to shape new ways of working. With many planning and performance management processes yet to be formalised, you will play a key role in designing the frameworks, tools and governance needed to support future growth and enable the organisation to scale efficiently.




Responsibilities:

Capacity planning and resource forecasting across the project portfolio, ensuring effective allocation of the Project Management team, currently consisting of four Project Managers, as well as other dedicated project resources
FTE modelling and workforce planning
Portfolio and scenario analysis to support business decisions
Capacity analysis and identification of bottlenecks and improvement opportunities
Development of planning models, reporting tools and visual dashboards
Coordination of monthly portfolio review processes and management reporting
Facilitation of workshops and cross-functional initiatives to improve productivity and delivery flow




Qualifications:

You hold a relevant academic degree within business, project management, engineering, life sciences or a related field. You have experience working with business planning, business analysis, resource and capacity planning, portfolio management or other analytical disciplines where data, forecasting and decision support are central elements.




You are comfortable working with large amounts of data and translating complex information into clear analyses, forecasts and recommendations. Ideally, you have experience supporting management with planning, prioritisation and resource allocation in a project-based or operational environment.




As a person, you are analytical, structured and curious by nature. You enjoy understanding how an organisation operates and are motivated by turning complexity into transparency and actionable insights. At the same time, you are skilled at building relationships across functions and facilitating dialogue between stakeholders with different perspectives and priorities.




You have strong Excel skills, experience with reporting and data visualisation tools, and proficiency in English, both spoken and written.




We offer:

At Unilabs Pharma Solutions, you will work closely with management and gain significant influence in an organisation undergoing transformation and growth. You will play a key role in creating the transparency, planning and analytical foundation that enables the organisation to make informed decisions, utilise resources effectively and continue to scale.




Reporting directly to the Head of Site Copenhagen, you will work closely with key stakeholders across the business, gaining broad business insight and the opportunity to shape how planning, prioritisation and decision support are developed in the future. The role offers both professional and personal development in a small, informal workplace where colleagues support each other and where your contribution will have a visible impact.




The position is based at Unilabs’ office on Nygårdsvej 32 in Copenhagen Ø. If you are analytical, a good listener and motivated by turning complexity into clear insights and actionable solutions, we look forward to receiving your application.




About Unilabs Pharma Solutions:

Unilabs Pharma Solutions supports pharmaceutical and biotech companies throughout the later stages of drug development, helping bring innovative therapies safely to patients around the world. As part of the wider Unilabs Group, one of Europe’s leading diagnostic providers, the organisation combines scientific expertise, specialised laboratory capabilities and project delivery excellence to support customers from clinical studies through to post-market activities.

Title: Senior Performance Intelligence Manager
Place: Humlebæk, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you an analytical and technically strong performance manager who can translate complex R&D data into decision-ready insights? Do you have experience designing performance frameworks, KPI architectures, and portfolio intelligence capabilities that help senior leaders prioritize investments, strengthen business performance, and maximize innovation value?

Join our PMO, Innovation Portfolio Management within R&D Chronic Care organisation

Coloplast has a long history of developing innovative products that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. At our headquarters in Humlebæk, you will join the PMO department within the R&D Innovation Portfolio Management organization, where we drive portfolio management and execution across the innovation portfolio, enable strategy deployment, and advance performance management across the R&D organization.

As Senior Performance Intelligence Manager, you will play a key role in establishing a trusted performance management system across R&D. You will create a single source of truth for portfolio, functional, and organizational performance, enabling leaders across the organization to make better business decisions, strengthen business performance, and maximize the value delivered through innovation investments. Through KPI frameworks, dashboards, analytics, and performance insights, you will help leaders to drive continuous performance improvement across both the Innovation Value Stream portfolio and the wider R&D organization, ensuring leaders have the insights needed to improve outcomes, productivity, and value delivery

Turn performance insights into better R&D decisions

In this role, you move beyond traditional reporting. You will help build the performance foundation that gives R&D leadership one trusted view of performance and portfolio progress, risk and value — so they can act with confidence.

Your key responsibilities include:


Develop and maintain performance management framework and KPI matrix used to track value creation across the IVS portfolio and R&D organisation.
Design and build the Power BI data model, dashboards and reporting logic, from architecture through to visual design
Establish one trusted source of truth for portfolio, business and value performance, supporting better decisions and performance improvement across R&D and the Innovation Value Stream
Create one integrated portfolio view of milestones, cost, risk and value across programs and projects
Turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support value-optimising decisions for senior leadership
Work closely with Finance, R&D and IVS stakeholders to provide insights and analytical support that help leaders improve business performance, identify improvement opportunities, and make better business decisions
Develop and run value realization tracking, ensuring initiatives deliver against the impact they promised
Support portfolio scenario design and decision preparation with fact-based analysis
Apply hands-on BI, AI, data and analytics capabilities to improve reporting quality, automation and insight generation




Turn complexity into clear insights and recommendations

First and foremost, you are an analytical, technically strong performance manager who builds dashboards people actually trust. When you present a number, stakeholders don't question whether it's right — they ask what it means for the decision ahead.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy creating structure where complexity exists. You turn fragmented information into insights that leaders can act on, and you're motivated by building performance management practices that create real business value.

You combine business understanding with solid hands-on BI, data and analytics experience. You are comfortable working with data models, dashboards, reporting logic and performance metrics — and you can translate technical complexity into clear insights for senior stakeholders.

What you bring:


Minimum 5 years of experience in performance management, strategic PMO, portfolio management, business performance, or analytics-driven decision support
Master’s degree in business, Finance, Engineering, Data/Analytics, Life Science, Technology or equivalent
Strong experience designing performance management frameworks, KPI architectures, dashboards, and decision-support capabilities in a project, program, or portfolio environment.
Solid hands-on technical experience building and developing Power BI reports and dashboards, including data modelling, reporting logic and visual design - this is a core, hands-on part of the role
Experience supporting portfolio scenario design, trade-off discussions and fact-based decision-making
Strong stakeholder management skills and a proactive, solution-oriented approach
Experience from R&D, medical devices, pharma, life science or another regulated industry — this is an advantage
Communicate effortlessly in written and spoken English




Interested?

If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Anna Revva, Head of PMO, R&D Innovation Portfolio Management at dkanre@coloplast.com.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.
