Title: Quantitative Risk Analyst
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Copenhagen, Denmark

About The Job

Are you at the start of your career and ready to help shape Saxo's balance sheet analytics, risk frameworks, and treasury decision-making through data, modelling and quantitative analysis?

We are looking for a talented and motivated Quantitative Risk Analyst to join our Market & Treasury Risk team within Risk Strategy & Treasury. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of treasury, risk management, quantitative modelling, and strategic decision-making.

Our team plays a central role in shaping Saxo's earnings profile and balance sheet risks, including liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk and capital risk. We develop and maintain the analytical frameworks, models and methodologies that support balance sheet optimisation, risk management and senior management decision-making across the organisation.

As part of the team, you will contribute to the development of quantitative models, risk metrics as well as analytical tools used to assess earnings, funding, liquidity and market risks. You will work closely with colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading and Technology, gaining broad exposure to the management of a modern international bank.

This role is particularly well suited to professionals in the earlier stages of their career looking to build deep expertise in treasury, risk management and quantitative analysis within an international banking environment.

Responsibilities

As our new Quantitative Risk Analyst, you will:


Develop and enhance quantitative models, methodologies, and risk measures relating to liquidity risk, interest rate risk, FX risk, and capital management.
Build analytical models, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide insights into earnings, funding, liquidity, and risk exposures.
Perform quantitative analysis of balance sheet developments, business initiatives, and market events to support risk and treasury decision-making.
Contribute to the automation and improvement of risk analytics using modern analytical tools and programming languages.
Assist in the development and validation of methodologies used for risk measurement, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Collaborate with stakeholders across Treasury, Finance, Risk, Trading, Secured Finance, and Technology to deliver scalable analytical solutions.
Support the preparation of analysis and material for senior management, risk committees, and regulatory interactions.
Support the ongoing development of analytical frameworks such as Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), Value of Client Funds (VCF), stress-testing methodologies, and balance sheet optimisation tools.


Your profile

This role is ideally suited to candidates with around 4-5 years of relevant experience who are looking to further develop their quantitative, analytical, and banking expertise while taking on increasing responsibility and ownership. We are also open to exceptional candidates with fewer years of experience if they bring highly relevant expertise and a strong foundation within the areas covered by the role.

You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems through data, modelling, and quantitative analysis. You are curious, detail-oriented, and motivated by understanding how financial and business decisions impact earnings, risk, and balance sheet performance.

You are comfortable working with data, challenging assumptions, and developing practical solutions while collaborating with both technical and business stakeholders.

In Addition, We Expect That You


Hold a relevant master's degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, physics, computer science or a related quantitative discipline.
Have experience with Python, SQL, R, AI/ML tools, or similar analytical and programming technologies
Possess strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience working with complex datasets and modelling frameworks.
Enjoy developing models, analytical tools, and scalable solutions to support business decision-making.
Have an interest in financial markets, banking, treasury or risk management.
Communicate clearly and explain analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Nice To Have


Experience with liquidity risk, FTP, IRRBB, market risk, stress testing, or capital management.
Knowledge of banking products, financial markets, or asset and liability management.
Experience with data visualisation, automation, or large-scale data analysis.
Familiarity with regulatory frameworks applicable to banks and financial institutions.


We get curious people invested in the world

When you work at Saxo, you become a Saxonian and part of a purpose-driven organisation, where good ideas are always taken seriously, and where you can make a true impact. We are invested in your development, and you can expect a robust career from day one when you join Saxo – no matter which role you take on.

You will join 2,500 other ambitious colleagues across 11 countries and become part of an international organisation. Working in Saxo, you will get to meet colleagues from many different cultures and backgrounds, and you should know that we value diversity and inclusion and see it as a genuine source of strength to drive growth, foster innovation and position us for long-term success.

We encourage an open feedback culture and supportive team environments enabling employees to grow and fulfil their career aspirations.

When you bring passion, curiosity, drive and team spirit, your learning journey will be dynamic and your career opportunities in Saxo will be immense.

At Saxo we don’t just offer a job – we offer an opportunity to invest in your future!

How To Apply

Click here to create an account and upload your resume and a short motivation. We look forward to getting to know you better!

Title: Legal Tech Operations Consultant
Description:
Vil du være med til at omsætte data og AI til konkrete løsninger på komplekse juridiske sager?




I Legal Tech Operations arbejder vi med data og teknologi, der skal fungere i en juridisk hverdag med høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed og sikkerhed. Du får ansvar for konkrete opgaver på rigtige sager og er med til at udvikle og forbedre de løsninger, der hjælper os med at levere juridisk rådgivning.




Bliv en del af Legal Tech Operations

Vi er et lille, teknisk stærkt team med ingeniører, data scientists og økonomer. Vi udvikler løsninger i tæt samarbejde med juristerne i huset - blandt andet ved at gøre store, ustrukturerede dokumentmængder til data, der kan analyseres og bruges i rådgivningen.




Det bliver en del af din hverdag

Du arbejder både praktisk med data fra konkrete sager og med at udvikle bedre metoder og værktøjer. Dine opgaver afhænger af din profil og de aktuelle sager, men kan blandt andet være at:




indsamle, udtrække, deduplikere og strukturere store dokumentmængder i forskellige filformater.
analysere sagsdata, finde mønstre og gennemføre stikprøvebaserede kvalitetskontroller.
løse konkrete data- og analyseopgaver på sager og omsætte erfaringerne til nye løsninger.
kvalitetssikre pipelines og modeller gennem test, stikprøver og systematisk evaluering.
rapportere og visualisere data, så jurister og klienter får et bedre overblik.




Afhængigt af opgaverne får du også mulighed for at arbejde med blandt andet RAG, embeddings, indeksering og evaluering af AI-løsninger, datapipelines, FastAPI, OCR og Azure AI Document Intelligence. Vi arbejder også med kildeverifikation, skemavalidering og deployment på egen infrastruktur med Docker.




Du får ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig

Du får ansvar tidligt, men du står ikke alene. Vi drøfter løbende sager, metoder og resultater i teamet, og du får sparring på dit arbejde. Du følger løsninger fra idé og prototype til brug på konkrete sager og får direkte feedback fra juristerne, der anvender dem.

Rollen giver dig mulighed for at udvikle dig i krydsfeltet mellem data science, AI og praktisk problemløsning. Du får erfaring med at bygge, evaluere og drive løsninger i en juridisk kontekst, hvor præcision og kvalitet har stor betydning.




Vi forestiller os, at du

Du er tidligt i din karriere og har et solidt fundament i dataanalyse og problemløsning. Du kan være nyuddannet inden for data science, matematik, økonomi, datalogi eller et beslægtet område, eller du kan have nogle års erfaring med eksempelvis softwareudvikling, data science eller teknologirådgivning.




Vi forventer, at du:




kan analysere data og formidle dine resultater klart.
arbejder systematisk og struktureret og har blik for detaljer.
tager korrekthed og sikkerhed alvorligt.
har lyst til at lære at udvikle, evaluere og drive løsninger - både med og uden AI.
kan arbejde professionelt på dansk og engelsk.




Studieprojekter, egne dataprojekter og relevant erhvervserfaring tæller positivt. Det er også en fordel, hvis du kender rådgivnings- eller advokatbranchen eller har arbejdet med eksempelvis Git eller Docker, men det er ikke et krav. Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra dag ét. Har du et stærkt udgangspunkt, nysgerrighed og lyst til at udvikle dig, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.




Om os

Bech-Bruun er i toppen af danske advokatfirmaer. Vi rådgiver på tværs af erhvervsjuraens områder og arbejder tæt sammen - både med vores klienter og på tværs af specialer - for at skabe klarhed og et sikkert grundlag for beslutninger. Vi kombinerer dyb faglighed med et kommercielt blik og bruger blandt andet Legal Tech og AI til at styrke vores rådgivning.

Hos os bliver du udfordret af dygtige kolleger og får mulighed for at arbejde med komplekse juridiske problemstillinger, hvor faglighed, samarbejde og forretningsforståelse går hånd i hånd. Du får ansvar og mulighed for at udvikle dig gennem opgaverne og for at bringe dine egne kompetencer i spil.




Er du klar til næste skridt?

Er det dig, vi leder efter? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via vores hjemmeside. Vi holder samtaler løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Senior Legal Tech Operations Manager Jonas William Abbotts på telefon 25 26 35 95 eller mail JWA@bechbruun.com.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!




Ansøgningsfristen er den 19. oktober 2026.

Title: BI Developer
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Have an appetite for more?

Do you enjoy turning data into insights that drive better decisions? As a Business Intelligence (BI) Developer at Lantmännen Unibake, you will build Power BI solutions that help colleagues across our global business make smarter, data-driven decisions.

Lantmännen Unibake is one of the world's leading bakery groups, operating in more than 20 countries and partnering with global brands such as McDonald's, Starbucks and Aldi. Based at our international HQ in Copenhagen, you will join a collaborative Data, Analytics and Integrations team and play a key role in shaping how data is used across our business.

This Is What You Will Do

As a BI Developer (internally referred to as BI Specialist), you will act as the link between business stakeholders and our data team, translating their goals and requirements into scalable analytics solutions, typically built on Power BI. From development new reports from scratch through to enhancing our existing products, you will build models and reports that create real business value for our units, supporting over 800 users on a weekly basis.

Your Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across HQ and our business units to understand their requirements and deliver impactful BI solutions.
Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and visualizations that support data-driven decision-making.
Build and optimize data models using DAX, Power Query and BI best practices.
Work closely with Data Engineers to ensure reliable and scalable reporting solutions built on our Unibake Data Platform, using the latest Snowflake technologies
Drive user adoption through training, demonstrations, testing and stakeholder engagement.
Continuously improve existing reports and dashboards to enhance performance and business value.
Provide ongoing support for our global BI community and promote analytics best practices across the organization.


,

What You Bring


3+ years of experience working with Power BI, including developing dashboards, reports and data models using DAX, with good knowledge of best practices for scalable enterprise solutions
Strong knowledge of SQL, Power Query and Row-Level Security (RLS)
Experience with Snowflake, Azure DevOps, or Tabular Editor is considered an advantage.
Previous exposure to the manufacturing industry is highly valued.
A talent for translating business requirements into intuitive and impactful analytics solutions.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with the confidence to present solutions to business users.
A proactive and analytical mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities.


What We Offer


Competitive salary package.
10% pension contribution and health insurance.
Internet allowance, company phone and free parking.
A collaborative office-first HQ environment where you can learn, innovate and build relationships with colleagues from 31+ nationalities.
International career opportunities within a growing global organization.
Company events and activities


Location / Travel

The role is based at Lantmännen Unibake International HQ in Copenhagen, Ørestad, one minute from the Metro.

Expect around 10-15 travel days per year, mainly during key project phases.

Sounds interesting?

Ready to help shape the future of data-driven decision-making at Lantmännen Unibake?

We would love to hear from you. Please apply with your English CV as soon as possible, as we interview candidates on an ongoing basis.
